jobs.title: Intermediate Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An Overview Of This Role

As a Technical Program Manager in GitLab’s R&D organization, you’ll lead cross functional initiatives that help teams deliver reliably, efficiently, and at scale. You’ll own programs that cut across multiple product stages and engineering teams, turning strategic priorities into clear plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving progress in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You’ll use GitLab issues, epics, and handbook-first documentation to create visibility, remove blockers, and keep complex work moving across time zones, while partnering closely with Engineering Leadership at all levels. In your first year, you’ll be expected to independently run a portfolio of programs from scoping through delivery and retrospectives, and to improve how R&D programs operate by contributing to and evolving Technical Program Management best practices.

What You’ll Do

Lead 1–3 strategic technical programs at a time spanning multiple engineering teams and product stages, ensuring clear scope, priorities, and outcomes.
Partner with engineering leaders and other key stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and delivery milestones for cross functional initiatives.
Own end-to-end program planning and execution, from initial discovery and scoping through delivery, measurement, and retrospectives.
Drive asynchronous collaboration using GitLab issues, epics, and handbook updates so globally distributed teams stay aligned and informed.
Identify risks and blockers early, coordinate resolution across teams, and escalate when needed to maintain momentum.
Facilitate working group meetings and async discussions to support decision-making, surface tradeoffs, and keep programs on track.
Track and communicate program health through metrics, dashboards, and regular status updates to provide visibility to the Engineering Division and partners.
Contribute to evolving Technical Program Management practices by documenting processes, sharing learnings, and improving how R&D programs run across GitLab.

What You’ll Bring

Experience in technical program management, project management, software engineering, or similar technical roles.
Understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile ways of working, including how engineering teams plan, build, and ship.
Skill in coordinating programs across multiple engineering teams or departments, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, and milestones.
Strong written communication skills for asynchronous, documentation-first collaboration in a fully remote environment.
Ability to work independently in a distributed setting, set priorities, and make progress with minimal supervision.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying blockers, and proposing practical solutions to keep programs moving.
Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or platforms like GitLab, with interest in deepening this knowledge over time.
Openness to learning, iterating based on feedback, and applying transferable skills from varied backgrounds to technical program management.

About The Team

You’ll join the R&D organization as part of the Technical Program Management function, a small, cross-functional team that leads high-impact programs spanning multiple product stages and departments. The team focuses on driving clarity, alignment, and predictable delivery for complex initiatives that touch many parts of GitLab, using a handbook-first, asynchronous way of working with stakeholders across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and partners in other functions to improve how programs are planned, executed, and communicated, helping evolve shared practices, templates, and tooling for program governance across R&D.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines:
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Manager based in Canada.

This is a senior technical project management role focused on delivering cloud-based contact center and customer experience solutions.

You will lead complex Amazon Connect implementations from discovery and planning through technical delivery, testing, and client handoff.

The role combines strong project leadership with hands-on understanding of AWS services, integrations, and contact center technologies.

You’ll coordinate cross-functional technical teams while serving as a trusted point of contact for clients throughout implementation.

The position offers exposure to AI-powered customer experience solutions, cloud-native architectures, analytics, automation, and modern DevOps practices.

You’ll also contribute to delivery standards, reusable implementation assets, continuous improvement, and technical knowledge sharing.

This is a fully remote opportunity within a global environment, with travel of up to 50% depending on business needs.

Accountabilities

Lead end-to-end project management for Amazon Connect implementations, from initial discovery and planning through delivery, testing, adoption, and client handoff.
Develop project plans covering milestones, deliverables, resources, dependencies, schedules, budgets, and project governance.
Serve as a primary technical contact for clients, building strong relationships and maintaining clear communication throughout implementations.
Facilitate communication between client stakeholders, technical teams, leadership, architects, and other project contributors.
Manage scope, schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, priorities, and quality standards while proactively addressing project issues.
Oversee the implementation and configuration of Amazon Connect, including contact flows, queues, routing strategies, IVR functionality, agent experiences, and related capabilities.
Coordinate integrations between Amazon Connect and CRM platforms, knowledge bases, enterprise applications, and other client systems.
Guide the implementation of AI and machine-learning capabilities using services such as Amazon Lex and Amazon Polly.
Ensure technical solutions align with AWS best practices for security, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
Coordinate functional, performance, and user acceptance testing and validate solutions against client requirements and performance expectations.
Collaborate with solutions architects to design customized customer experience solutions leveraging the broader AWS ecosystem.
Oversee custom components, integrations, analytics, reporting solutions, and CI/CD capabilities supporting Amazon Connect deployments.
Coordinate knowledge transfer to client teams and managed services teams to support successful adoption and ongoing operations.
Develop reusable implementation assets, templates, documentation, and best practices to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
Monitor developments across Amazon Connect and AWS services and identify opportunities to improve implementation approaches and solution quality.
Contribute to client-facing presentations, demonstrations, thought leadership, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Mentor junior team members and share expertise in Amazon Connect, AWS, project delivery, and implementation best practices.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
At least 5 years of technical project management experience, including responsibility for complex technology implementations.
At least 3 years of experience working with AWS cloud technologies.
Demonstrated experience with contact center technologies and customer experience solutions.
Strong experience managing technical projects across scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or equivalent.
Experience working with both Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies.
Strong client relationship management and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience with Amazon Connect is strongly valued, including contact flows, queues, routing, IVR, agent workspace, reporting, analytics, outbound campaigns, and Contact Lens.
Strong knowledge of AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Kinesis, QuickSight, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, Step Functions, EventBridge, Lex, and Polly is an asset.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate or Professional certification is preferred.
Experience with IVR systems, CTI integrations, telephony technologies, CRM platforms, AI/ML technologies, or contact center operations is an asset.
Familiarity with Python, Node.js, infrastructure-as-code tools, or CI/CD practices is beneficial.
Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and leadership skills.
Ability to work effectively in a remote, global, and cross-functional environment.
Willingness to travel up to approximately 50% depending on business requirements.
Must be legally authorized to work in Canada; employer-sponsored visa support is not available.

Benefits

Base salary range of CAD $131,520–$157,824 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.
Additional compensation may include bonuses, commissions, equity, and other incentives based on the role and applicable performance factors.
100% remote work within Canada.

jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager | Real Estate
jobs.description:
About us

IMSOLD Agency is the agency arm of an AI-first venture studio. We don't run campaigns for clients and hand over a report — we build and operate brands end to end: research, creative, funnels, media buying, tech, and the teams that run them. Our portfolio spans health, wellness, B2B software, and real estate across the US, Europe, and the Middle East. This role sits on our Dubai real estate lead-generation account — a fast-moving operation connecting property owners and investors with licensed Dubai real estate professionals.

About the role

You orchestrate the complete marketing flow of the brand — from verified research foundations to a running content calendar — then hand off to production, which runs on our proprietary operations platform. You do not produce the work. Specialist teams handle research, copywriting, design, video, publishing, and legal review. Your job is rarer: to see the whole machine, verify that every input exists and is sound before work starts, spot the missing dependency before it breaks something downstream, and keep a dozen specialists in time. Six verbs describe the day-to-day: verify → chase → assemble → agree → build → hand off. 

What you'll do

Verify the brand's marketing foundations — market and competitor research, audience definitions, messaging inputs, legal constraints — and trigger the right specialist team when a layer is missing or below the bar
Assemble all verified inputs into one content plan for the brand 
Agree the content rhythm — channels, campaign mix, volume — directly with the brand's leadership
Build the content calendar so that every slot has its creative, caption, call-to-action, and a destination that actually exists
Hand off cleanly to production and keep the machine flowing: chase blockers, reconcile numbers, route every creative through compliance review before launch
Quality-control what comes back: catch contradictions, impossible numbers, and unsourced claims before they reach anyone downstream

What we're looking for

3+ years running performance-marketing, direct-response, or growth projects — owning the system, not just executing tasks in it
Hands-on familiarity with paid social funnels (Meta especially): you don't have to be the media buyer, but you must understand CPMs, CTR, CPL, and funnel math well enough to manage one
Proven ability to orchestrate a team of specialists to ship on deadline — and to tell someone their work is broken when it is
An instinct for dependencies: you naturally order work by what must exist first, and you treat "done" as something to verify, not something to accept
Fluent, precise written English — this is an async, remote, documentation-heavy environment 

Real estate experience — a strong plus, in this order

Dubai / UAE property market experience:
You've marketed in or to the Dubai real estate market — brokerage marketing, property portals or proptech, developer marketing, or lead generation for UAE realtors — and you know its advertising rules and market dynamics first-hand.
Property-market experience
anywhere You've run marketing operations or lead generation in any serious property market. The instincts transfer; the Dubai specifics are teachable.
Also welcome No property background
— but a world-class operator If you've orchestrated complex marketing systems in other industries and everything above describes you, we still want to hear from you. We hire the best operator in the pool. 

What this role is not

Not a real estate sales role — no transactions, no client calls, no commissions
Not a content-production role — you won't write scripts, design, or edit video
Not a media-buying role — specialists run the ads; you run the flow

What we offer

Fully remote work with high autonomy and high standards — you'll be trusted to run things, and held to the results
A documented, systemized operation: you inherit a complete written playbook, not chaos
Exposure to a multi-brand venture studio and a modern AI-native marketing stack
Long-term growth: strong moderators take on additional brands across the portfolio

How to apply

Send your CV to hr@imsold.com
with the subject line " Marketing Project Manager — Real Estate
" and include, in the body of your message:
In exactly five sentences: describe one system or process you personally kept on the rails — what its moving parts were, what broke most often, and how you caught it early
Your real estate / Dubai market experience, if any (be specific — markets, companies, campaigns)
Your monthly salary expectation and earliest start date

(Applications that skip the five-sentence answer will not be reviewed — following the instruction is part of the test. Shortlisted candidates complete a recorded 20–25 minute first-line interview conducted by our AI interviewer, followed by a live assessment session and a paid trial task.)

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Quantum Computing Applied Research
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s motivated by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can develop a lasting impact on the world.

Quantum computing is accelerating from lab to utility, and NVIDIA sits at the center of that shift. We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact strategic R&D initiatives within quantum computing. You will lead across our applied research R&D roadmap to craft clarity and success. We are innovating groundbreaking techniques for quantum in AI and accelerated computing, so that useful fault-tolerant quantum computing arrives sooner. Partner across engineering, applied research, and product teams inside NVIDIA, and with external collaborators, you will build and operationalize innovation roadmaps that pioneer ahead. Success in this role includes outstanding program leadership, communication, and problem solving. If you're passionate about bringing quantum computing into the fault-tolerant era with accelerated computing, we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

Initiate and lead multiple concurrent technical programs across our quantum computing portfolio, with emphasis on bringing the full power of accelerated computing to the field.
Define clear execution plans and measurable outcomes from our R&D and technology roadmaps, then lown the work to success across teams.
Identify & prioritize the most critical activities required for the research's success, and ensure that they are completed.
Develop a strong technical understanding of our R&D priorities, to enable successful collaborations, and proactively identify new opportunities.
Creatively solve and mitigate technical challenges, while establishing early risk identification and mitigations.
Serve as a link between research and engineering, moving new technologies from incubation to scalable solutions.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.
10+ years of technical program management experience leading large-scale, cross-functional technology initiatives, including multiple sophisticated programs at once and execution alongside research, engineering, and technical leadership.
Validated understanding of the quantum computing ecosystem and technologies, including hardware and software.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate sophisticated technical concepts for a range of audiences.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Advanced degree (MS or PhD or equivalent) in quantum information science, physics, or a closely related field, or hands-on research or engineering experience inside a quantum program.
Background in translating research output to developed technology.
Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing, HPC environments, or hybrid quantum-classical workflows and the tooling around them.
Experience running joint technical programs with national laboratories, companies, universities, or research institutions.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 19, 2026.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager (Delivery Support)
jobs.description:
Billennium to firma technologiczna z ponad 20-letnim doświadczeniem. Przez ten czas nauczyliśmy się jednego – projekty trzeba nie tylko dobrze zaplanować, ale przede wszystkim dowieźć. Dlatego stawiamy na współpracę, konkret i sensowne podejście do delivery.

Szukamy osoby na stanowisko IT Project Managera
, która poza klasycznym prowadzeniem projektów wejdzie również w rolę „delivery supportu” – pomoże nam spinać kluczowe tematy i odciąży Delivery Managerów tam, gdzie naprawdę ma to znaczenie.

Zajmiesz się:

Prowadzeniem projektów end-to-end (harmonogram, budżet / rentowność / marża, zakres, jakość)
Operacyjnym dowożeniem projektów, aby odciążyć Delivery Managerów
Pilnowaniem realizacji projektów na czas, w wymaganej jakości i zgodnie z założeniami
Koordynowaniem zespołów, dostawców i interesariuszy
Monitorowaniem ryzyk i reagowaniem zanim staną się problemem
Dbaniem o raportowanie, statusy i transparentną komunikację
Wspieraniem Delivery Managerów w ich kluczowych projektach jako ich „prawa ręka”
Wspieraniem obszaru compliance (bez odpowiedzialności za sprzedaż)
Utrzymywaniem tempa i jakości delivery, aby Delivery Managerowie mogli skupić się na nowych inicjatywach
Dbaniem o dobrą komunikację w projektach – jasną, konkretną i budującą zaufanie

Szukamy osoby, która:

Jest mocnym Project Managerem i ma za sobą min. 5 lat doświadczenia w projektach IT
Potrafi prowadzić duże i złożone projekty (np. o budżecie na poziomie kilku mln PLN)
Ogarnia delivery — potrafi dopilnować dowiezienia projektu, nie tylko go zaplanować
Potrafi pracować z wieloma interesariuszami
Umie odciążyć Delivery Managera i przejąć część odpowiedzialności operacyjnej
Jest samodzielna, proaktywna i dobrze zorganizowana
Ma doświadczenie w prowadzeniu projektów end-to-end (od inicjacji po wdrożenie i stabilizację)
Rozumie, jak powstają i są wdrażane systemy IT oraz potrafi o tym rozmawiać z zespołem i klientem
Komunikuje się jasno, jest otwarta na feedback i buduje dobre relacje w projekcie
Zna metodyki project management (PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall)
Posiada certyfikat PRINCE2 Practitioner, AgilePM Practitioner lub równoważny
Pracuje z narzędziami projektowymi (np. Jira, MS Project, Confluence)

Nasza oferta:

Pakiet benefitów pozapłacowych — korzystaj z Udemy for Business, prywatnej opieki medycznej, karty Multisport, pakietu weterynaryjnego, lekcji językowych i bonów zakupowych.
Elastyczność — elastyczne godziny pracy i opcje pracy zdalnej/hybrydowej dostosowane do Twojego stylu życia i lokalizcji.
Rozwój kariery — dostęp do możliwości rozwoju zawodowego i nauki, w tym korzyści związanych z naszymi oficjalnymi partnerstwami z globalnymi gigantami IT, m.in. Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, Salesforce.
Angażująca społeczność — praca z pełnymi pasji profesjonalistami i udział w wydarzeniach team buildingowych, hackathonach i inicjatywach CSR.
Wydarzenia team buildingowe, w tym nasza tradycja firmowa (coroczne wydarzenie firmowe na Mazurach).

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

About The Role

Are you passionate about renewable energy and ready to make a tangible impact? Do you thrive on managing end-to-end projects and customer relationships? Are you excited to join a dynamic and collaborative team that is shaping the future of sustainable power? If so, apply now for the Project Manager role at GreenPowerMonitor (GPM). Together, we can create a greener tomorrow!

You will drive planning, execution, and delivery of key projects focused on implementing GPM data-driven digital solutions (SCADA &PPC) for the control, monitoring, and asset management of renewable energy sites, including photovoltaic, wind, and battery storage. You will collaborate closely with our customers and internal teams to ensure successful project outcomes.

Your Key Responsibilities

Oversee end-to-end project management, from the receipt of the Purchase Order to the successful delivery and final acceptance by the customer
Define project requirements to ensure alignment with customer needs and develop detailed project plans, including milestones, timelines, resource allocation, and risk management
Supervise and delegate project tasks across Project Engineers and cross-functional teams (logistics, purchasing, IT, GI,…) ensuring efficient task distribution and execution
Oversee purchasing and supplier assignments, ensuring timely procurement of materials and services required for project success
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while meeting customer requirements and quality standards
Act as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships and expectations throughout the project lifecycle
Write technical reports and communicate progress, challenges, and solutions to stakeholders, both internally and externally on a regular basis
Continuously drive process improvements and best practices in project management

The team awaiting you…

You will join our Project Execution team in the On-site Solutions area. Our commitment is to successfully deliver On-site Solutions (SCADA and PPC) projects, while ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, and budget constraints. This involves a comprehensive approach that not only prioritizes excellence but also emphasizes efficiency and performance to provide the optimum experience and highest quality to our customers. To achieve this, we actively create specific tools and automation processes, enabling us to deliver intelligently and uphold our position as industry leaders.

GreenPowerMonitor, a DNV company, is at the heart of the global energy transformation. We use data-driven digital solutions to optimise the performance of renewable energy installations around the world. Our work contributes to a more diverse, more sustainable global energy mix.

What we offer

Wellbeing: DNV understands the importance of physical and mental wellbeing and aligned with our value of caring for our people, we have a ‘Be Well’ program in place.
Bonus opportunity: We believe it is important to reward our employees with an annual discretionary profit scheme or sales incentive scheme – depending on your role.
Insurances: DNV covers permanent employees for life and total permanent disability insurance as well as salary continuance insurance to safeguard you within our DNV Superannuation scheme.
Parental and long service leave: DNV has a generous parental leave and long service leave policy.
Hybrid work: We offer a hybrid work model to foster our culture while providing you with working flexibility.
Professional membership: We will support you with membership fees for your relevant governing body applicable to your position.
Social activities: To foster our culture, we enjoy regular social get togethers. DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

About You

To thrive and succeed, we expect you to have:

Minimum a bachelor´s degree in engineering.
4-5 years of experience in project management in the renewable energy industry (photovoltaic, wind, and/or battery storage domains).
Experience with monitoring and control systems such as SCADA.
A proven track record of driving commercial & industrial (C&I) and/or utility-scale projects to successful completion on time and within budget.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders and deliver high-quality work.
Customer-oriented mindset with a commitment to understanding and addressing client needs.
Fluency in written and spoken English

It Would Be a Plus To Have

Certifications in project management
Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, IEC 60870‑5‑104 (IEC104), IEC 61850, DNP3, or similar.

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

jobs.title: Procurement Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

As a Direct Materials Productivity Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for driving productivity improvements and cost efficiencies in the direct materials supply chain. Your role will focus on optimizing procurement strategies, enhancing supplier performance, and ensuring the seamless flow of materials to support manufacturing and operational objectives. You will leverage your expertise in supply chain management and data analytics to identify opportunities for cost reduction and process enhancement, contributing directly to Honeywell’s competitive advantage and profitability.

You will report directly to the Senior Director Procurement for Process Automation and you’ll work out from one our India locations (Bangalore/Hyderabed/Pune) on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact Honeywell’s operational efficiency by leading initiatives that improve material cost productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen supplier partnerships. Your leadership will ensure that material availability aligns with production demands while maintaining cost targets and quality standards, thereby supporting the company’s overall business goals.

Your role also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end to end processes and project for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on task to be performed; and monitoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skills development, professional growth, and overall success.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement direct materials productivity strategies aligned with business objectives to drive cost savings and operational efficiencies.
Responsible for execution of productivity projects and achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets
Responsible for developing a pipeline of productivity projects working cross-functionally with strategic sourcing, factory operations, engineering, offering management and suppliers globally
Responsible for achieving the productivity targets for all the levers i.e. Negotiations, Value Engineering, Component Engineering, Rebates and Deflation with the objective of achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity targets
Analyze procurement data and supplier performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
Analyze spend receipts data and find opportunities for cost savings working closely with supplier sourcing leaders and procurement operations
Collaborate closely with procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to optimize material specifications, sourcing strategies, and inventory management.
Lead supplier engagement initiatives to improve cost competitiveness.
Manage cross-functional projects focused on waste reduction, process improvements, and supply chain optimization.
Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to direct materials productivity and cost savings to senior leadership.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain processes.
Support the development and deployment of procurement tools and technologies to improve data visibility and decision-making.
Mentor and develop team members to build capabilities in materials productivity and supply chain excellence.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
5+ years of relevant experience in direct materials productivity or supply chain management roles.
Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to driving change.
Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team environment.

WE VALUE

Proven experience in managing direct materials procurement and productivity within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and drive actionable insights.
Expertise in supplier management, contract negotiation, and cost reduction strategies.
Proficiency with ERP systems, procurement software, and data analysis tools.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing projects that deliver measurable productivity improvements.

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Events
jobs.description:
A Little About Us

Capricorn is one of Australia and New Zealand’s largest and most dynamic Member-owned organisations. Since 1974, we’ve provided our Members with financial and business solutions to make running a business easier. Our flagship Trade Account offers instant credit with over 1600 Preferred Suppliers, simplified monthly expenses, and a generous rewards program.

We have a strong foundation in the automotive and machinery aftermarkets. Our vibrant community includes over 31,000 Members across Australia and New Zealand, from national franchises to your local family workshop. Last year, Capricorn facilitated nearly $4bn in sales with our Preferred Suppliers.

At Capricorn, we're about more than just products and services. We work hard to ensure that our Members, Suppliers and People feel like they're part of something bigger: a Community which is connected and supported to make a difference, while having some fun along the way!

A Little About The Role

As Project Manager, you will manage the start-up, initiation and day-to-day management and governance of corporate projects and initiatives across the organisation but initially focused on supporting Capricorn’s Communications and Engagement team. The role supports tactical priorities and the Powering Forward 2030 Strategy by bringing structure, momentum and clear accountability to an increasing portfolio of work.

You will define scope, develop project plans and schedules, coordinate resources, manage budgets and risks, and keep stakeholders informed through clear reporting and governance. You will also monitor quality, evaluate outcomes and ensure agreed deliverables are achieved on time, within budget and to the required standard.

Your projects will include managing business-led initiatives and event programs such as Capricorn’s biennial Convention, Captivate, Gala Dinner and Trade Shows, as well as other initiatives currently planned by this team. By providing dedicated oversight for this work, you will reduce delivery risk and enable the Project Sponsor and business stakeholders to proceed with confidence and trust, knowing that these critical business calendar events are in safe hands.

What
you’ll bring

We’re looking for an experienced project manager who can bring disciplined planning, practical governance and confident stakeholder coordination across varied business and technology initiatives.

What’s Essential

At least five years’ experience planning, leading and managing project teams consisting of committed project resources and leveraged BAU/Operational staff to achieve project outcomes within project tolerances.
A strong application of project management disciplines to ensure that typical project controls including risk, issue, dependency, resource, change and budgets are effectively monitored, managed and maintained, with clear documentation and reporting.
Demonstrated understanding of systems and processes within a complex environment.
Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining close attention to detail and accuracy.
Sound knowledge of IT infrastructure, IT technologies
Practitioner level project management certification such as AgilePM, PRINCE2 or equivalent.

Highly regarded

Experience project managing or supporting the planning and management of major events, and documenting and delivering process and business systems improvements.
Experience working within an Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) where you will be expected to apply EPMO practices and contribute to the ongoing development and improvement of the EPMO capability.

Qualifications

A suitable project management certification and/or relevant tertiary qualification is required. PRINCE2 certification is desirable.

A little on life at Capricorn

Joining our community is about more than just a job, so here’s what’s in it for you:

Work flexibility – We're all unique, and so are the ways in which we work. We have Hybrid (2 days working from home) written into our policy.
Development Opportunities – your success is ours too. We provide training opportunities and development to give you the tools you need to grow.
Paid parental leave – during life's most important times, we support parents' leave (for both parents) and their transition back to work.
Get social – our social calendar is full, with a range of different virtual and face-to-face events to keep us connected.
A place you want to be – from the sweeping city views, coffee on tap and the general buzz of our team, Capricorn is a place you want to be.
A cherry on top – we've got a heap of benefits that our team actually use, including a fantastic reward and recognition program, wellness program, additional leave purchase and so much more!
Amazing Benefits – Unlock amazing benefits at Capricorn. We offer all staff free gym membership near the office, discounted private health benefits and all inclusive working from home kits to get you started!

Sound
like you’d be a good fit?

If you’re ready to bring structure, pace and strong governance to a varied portfolio of initiatives, we’d love to hear from you.

For further information, support with your application and details on Capricorn, please visit capricorn.coop/careers

Communication & Reporting: Provide concise, actionable updates to stakeholders and leadership on progress, changes, risks, and decisions.
Process & Continuous Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in workflows, propose improvements, and help implement better practices and tools.

Strong technical background with knowledge of software development methods, tools, and infrastructure.
Proven ability to communicate effectively with diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Results-oriented mindset with a bias toward clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Audience Development & Engagement
jobs.description:
The San Francisco Museum of Modern Art is one of the largest museums of modern and contemporary art in the United States and a thriving cultural center for the Bay Area. We cannot imagine life without art; it inspires and connects us every day. Now more than ever, these connections matter and are aligned with our values
.

Inclusive
: We strive to be a museum of many voices in dialogue.

Passionate
: We believe working with art is more than a job or trusteeship - it's a way of life.

Brave
: We are committed to approaching our work with courage and a sense of adventure, always ready to explore new perspectives.

Empathic
: We aim to act like a person, not an institution.

SFMOMA is a place for the infinitely curious to explore, support, and experience the art of our time. We believe that modern and contemporary art can influence the way we think, view the world, and embrace the many voices and perspectives around us. We aspire to foster an environment that elicits joy, nurtures a sense of belonging and purpose—where difference is seen as a strength, and every one is appreciated for their whole self.

Schedule
: Full Time, 35/hours per week, at least three days working onsite, occasional evenings and weekends required

The Program Manager, Audience Development & Engagement leads the strategy, development, and execution of programs designed to drive cultural relevance, engage diverse audiences, and deliver measurable audience growth.

This high-impact role creates broad-audience experiences that simultaneously generate revenue, enhance brand equity, and cultivate the next generation of SFMOMA visitors, with particular attention to audiences who may not see themselves as traditional museumgoers. The Program Manager seeks out unexpected partnerships, formats, and moments that help new audiences feel SFMOMA's relevance, while also finding ways to deepen the museum's relationship with frequent visitors and members. This role thinks in terms of the full visitor lifecycle — from first awareness to repeat, loyal engagement — and builds programs that move audiences along that path over time.

The projects can range from managing existing events and programs such as Rooftop Radio , organizing dynamic partner events and pop-ups, to audience surveying and research that builds a deeper understanding of who SFMOMA's audiences are, how they move from curiosity to commitment, and what sustains their long-term connection to the museum. This audience insight directly informs program design and iteration — the role is expected to pilot new ideas, test unconventional channels and partners, and resist formulaic programming in favor of approaches tailored to how different audience segments engage.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this position collaborates closely across departments to ensure all programming is exhibition-aligned, brand-coherent, and seamlessly integrated with museum operations — while keeping an eye on measurable outcomes across the full arc of the visitor relationship, not just single-event attendance.

Responsibilities & Duties

Experiential Programming Strategy & Execution: Own the end-to-end strategy, development, and execution of public-facing experiential programming designed to introduce SFMOMA to new audiences in unexpected contexts both inside and outside the museum, including piloting new formats and partnerships to test what resonates with different audience segments
Audience Insight & Segmentation: Lead audience surveying and research to build ongoing understanding of visitor segments, motivations, and behavior across the lifecycle — from first-time visitors to repeat and loyal audiences — and use these insights to inform program design, targeting, and iteration
Influencer & Creator Partnerships: In partnership with the Social Media Team, lead influencer and creator activations to drive cultural relevance and maximize earned media reach for select exhibitions, events, and programs.
Event Support:
Design member experience events in coordination with the Membership team to deepen loyalty and create aspirational access moments.
Execute press previews and media-facing activations in close partnership with the Communications team.
Partner with Public Events to deliver social programming (such as late-night member and public events that center experiences over curriculum)

Tourism & Convention Initiatives: Collaborate and support tourism-related experiences and events, including participation at annual conventions
Cross-Functional Workflow & Operations: Collaborate regularly with department leadership (Marketing, Communications, Visitor Experience, and Operations) to align priorities and ensure seamless cross-departmental execution
Strategic Measurement & Problem Solving: Drive strategic initiatives by implementing measurement systems, compiling audience and program data to solve complex operational problems, and preparing comprehensive impact reports that track progress across the visitor lifecycle
Maintain positive, collaborative relationships with people across the organization to ensure success of cross-functional initiatives

Qualifications & Skills

Minimum of six (6) years of experience in experiential marketing, cultural programming, brand partnerships, or public-facing live events within museums, live entertainment, hospitality, or creative agencies
Experience with audience research methods (surveys, focus groups, or visitor data analysis) and using insights to shape program strategy and targeting
Robust project management background, with a proven ability to manage multiple complex activations and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Position requires a high level of independence, discretion, and responsibility regarding high-visibility public matters and strategic partnerships
Highly organized, proactive, and capable of anticipating needs, establishing workflows for undefined processes, and navigating changing priorities with tight deadlines
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; capable of building positive, collaborative relationships across internal management, staff, trustees, donors, external creators, and media partners
Excellent computer skills, including strong proficiency in standard office suites and producing impactful presentations.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
NVIDIA's deep learning platforms are at the forefront of innovation, profoundly impacting various fields and widely adopted by leading academic institutions, startups, and major Internet companies globally. We're seeking an accomplished and highly skilled Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our NVIDIA DGX Cloud team. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate, focused, and creative individual to provide outstanding value to our DGX Cloud customers. We are specifically looking for a TPM with extensive background in cloud infrastructure bring-up with external partners. You will play a key role in collaborating with CSPs, emerging cloud providers and engineering teams internally to help build AI capacity and infrastructure across the globe!

What You'll Be Doing

As a DGX Cloud Technical Program Manager, you'll be a key partner to our Engineering, Infrastructure, Software teams and their leadership, driving critical programs related to AI capacity enablement and management. You'll play a pivotal role in developing and maturing foundational capabilities and processes for DGX Cloud, spanning critical areas such as cluster/capacity bring-up including CPU, storage, networking and compute requirements to support GPUs. This is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where TPMs are encouraged to apply fungible abilities to a range of high-impact programs within the DGX Cloud ecosystem.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Working in close coordination with storage engineering and network engineering teams to define and communicate requirements to CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Providers). Drive alignment and a POR for capacity blocks based on workload needs.
Drive early engagement with CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Providers) to understand their managed storage, network solutions and influence alignment with NVIDIA Cloud roadmap
Gathering technical requirements, developing comprehensive roadmaps, establishing clear turning points, and ensuring adherence to our Product Lifecycle (PLC) process.
Managing ongoing capacity operations and the engineering engagement with CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Provider) partners, collaborating closely with engineering leads. Focus on availability, maintenance and other critical performance indicators.
Partner closely within NVIDIA to understand workload requirements and related hardware and infrastructure needs. This includes speeds and feeds to optimize infrastructure readiness with cloud vendors and NVIDIA Cloud Providers.
Demonstrating Jira and other program management platforms to instill rigor and structure in the management of engineering deliverables.
Identifying and driving opportunities to onboard the adoption of third-party and in-house cloud infrastructure solutions for deployments, support, security, compliance and observability across DGX Cloud
Establishing key performance indicators (KPIs) and quantitatively demonstrating the value and impact delivered by your programs.
Proactively identifying, resolving, and mitigating risks and issues that could affect scope, schedule, and quality across all program aspects.
Encouraging a culture of continuous improvement, consistently seeing opportunities for process improvements within our cloud infrastructure operations.

What We Need To See

10+ years of technical program management experience. You have driven the planning and execution of large-scale cloud infrastructure programs with outside organizations. You focus strongly on software engineering projects within a matrixed organization.
Extensive hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, preferably gained from working at a major Cloud Service Provider (CSP).
Domain knowledge in the bring-up and end to end operations of compute, storage and GPU (including common failure points at the HW and SW levels).
Expert-level proficiency with Jira, Smartsheet, or similar program management tools, with the ability to expertly guide engineering teams on their use of the tools.
Outstanding strategic and tactical thinking abilities, coupled with a strong capacity to build consensus and drive program success
Comfort and efficiency in growing within ambiguous environments.
Possess excellent communication and technical presentation skills, particularly for executive audiences.
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

In depth knowledge of NVIDIA GPU products, including deployment and bring-up
Working knowledge of various cloud technologies (Kubernetes, API integration, Terraform, etc)
A highly enthusiastic, lively, responsive, and passionate individual who actively notices and addresses process improvement opportunities.
Significant experience with productivity tools and process automation is a major plus.
Deep familiarity with cloud-native product / services environments and familiarity with AI, ML infrastructure, and cloud/services

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We offer attractive compensation and an extensive benefits package. While planning your future, explore what we provide for you and your loved ones at www.nvidiabenefits.com/ We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

About the job JOB DESCRIPTION
Position Title

Program Manager
DepartmentEngineering
Reports ToEngineering ManagerDirect ReportsNil standing direct reports; a graduate engineer or program coordinator may be assigned.
Matrix leadership of cross-functional program teams drawn from Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial.

Position Overview
The Program Manager is accountable for the delivery of Microair Avionics' OEM customer programs and internal development projects, several running concurrently at different stages of maturity.Based at Microair's Indore facility and working across the company's Australian, US, Irish and Indian operations, the role converts customer commitments into achievable plans, keeps those plans honest as they meet reality, and removes whatever stands between the delivery team and the outcome.Authority is held over program scope, schedule baseline, budget and risk disposition within the approved contract, and the position is the delegated voice of Microair to the customer on program matters.Leadership is exercised through influence rather than line authority: the team creates the value, and the Program Manager's job is to enable it.

Key Responsibilities
1. Program OwnershipHold end-to-end accountability for multiple concurrent OEM delivery programs and development projects, from contract award through certification to entry into service and closeout.
2. Scope Translation & PlanningDissect the customer statement of work into a detailed, resourced and achievable plan — work breakdown, schedule, milestones and dependencies — expressed so the delivery team and the customer work from the same picture.
3. Team EnablementOperate on the basis that the team creates customer and company value, not the manager. Clear roadblocks, protect focus, and secure the resources and decisions the team is waiting on, including those held in another time zone.
4. Influence Without AuthoritySecure commitment, priority and follow-through from peers and their teams across Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial — and across the Indian, Australian, Irish and US sites — without relying on positional authority.
5. Customer EngagementAct as the principal customer-facing contact for assigned programs and represent Microair credibly at OEM design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and program gates, contributing to the technical discussion rather than deferring it.
6. Risk & Opportunity ManagementRun living risk and opportunity registers on every program, on the basis that unmanaged risk is the most likely cause of schedule slip. Own mitigations to closure and pursue opportunities with equal discipline.
7. Schedule, Cost & RevenueOwn program schedule, cost and revenue performance. Maintain credible forecasts, manage milestone claims and revenue timing, and escalate early and with options.
8. Change & Variation ControlIdentify scope change as it emerges, assess the schedule and cost impact, and agree variations with the customer before the work is quietly absorbed.
9. Value RealisationDefine how the value created by each program is measured, and test that against what the customer expects and pays for, so any gap surfaces while there is still time to act.

Skills & Experience
EducationBachelor degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in engineering or a related technical discipline — essential.
Formal program or project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent) — desirable.
A substantial delivery track record is accepted in lieu of formal qualifications.
ExperienceMinimum 8 years in engineering or technical delivery, including 4 years managing programs in their own right — essential.
Demonstrated ownership of several concurrent customer programs and development projects — essential.
Met schedule, cost and revenue commitments on fixed-price and milestone-based contracts — essential.
Managed distributed teams and customers across Indian, Australian, European and US time zones — essential.
Fluent professional English; willing to travel internationally to customer and Microair sites — essential.
Aerospace or avionics background — desirable; equivalent experience in another regulated safety-critical domain (defence electronics, automotive functional safety, medical devices, rail) is accepted.
Exposure to STC and TSO/ETSO certification schedules — desirable.
System KnowledgeScheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera or equivalent) and Microsoft 365 to intermediate Excel — essential.
Yogi for requirements and Xray for verification traceability, sufficient to read program status from the tools rather than from status meetings — desirable.
Dynamics 365 Business Central for cost, purchasing and material visibility — desirable.
Aircraft systems and avionics architecture sufficient to hold a technical conversation with an OEM; working awareness of ARP4754B, ARP4761A, DO-160, DO-178C and DO-254 — valued.

Engineering Program Manager

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Program Manager to drive planning, execution, and continuous improvement across our Engineering organization. You'll act as the execution orchestrator across Engineering — turning roadmap priorities into executable plans, keeping cross-team delivery on track, and making sure customer-impacting issues, releases, and demos move smoothly from commitment to completion.

You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), and Sales Engineers (SEs), and you'll need to influence outcomes without direct authority — bringing structure to ambiguous problems and surfacing risks early.

Key Responsibilities

1. Roadmap & Sprint Execution

Translate roadmap objectives into milestones, deliverables, and timelines across Engineering teams.
Own planning and tracking for sprints and projects: define dependencies, track scope changes and blockers, and flag delivery risk before it becomes slippage.
Sequence work across teams based on business priority, capacity, and dependencies; facilitate trade-off discussions when priorities conflict.
Maintain program dashboards as the single source of truth for delivery status.

2. Cross-Functional & Customer Issue Coordination

Serve as the coordination point between Engineering, Product, Customer Supoort, CSMs, and SEs on customer-reported issues.
Track issues from investigation through release and customer validation; drive aging or high-impact issues to resolution.
Ensure decisions, owners, and timelines are documented and communicated; escalate critical issues with clear context and recommended action.

3. Release & Demo Coordination

Coordinate releases across Development, QA, Product, and DevOps; own release timelines and readiness reviews.
Organize feature/sprint demos for CSMs, SEs, and Product; ensure feedback and action items get routed to the right owners.
Support post-release validation and retrospectives for major releases.

4. Quality, RCA & Continuous Improvement

Drive completion of Root Cause Analyses for significant customer-impacting bugs and recurring defects, with clear owners and target dates.
Analyze issue data to spot systemic patterns; partner with Customer Support, Engineering and Product on permanent fixes, not workarounds.
Facilitate retrospectives and ensure findings feed back into planning.

5. Process Improvement

Identify bottlenecks, gaps, and manual effort in existing workflows; design and standardize processes that improve predictability.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tracking and reporting.
Establish metrics to confirm process changes are actually working.
Tracking & Improving Customer Support SLAs.

6. Stakeholder Communication

Run a predictable communication cadence covering progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions needed.
Tailor updates for Engineering, Product, customer-facing teams, and leadership.
Proactively surface deviations from plan — don't wait for escalation.

What We're Looking For

5+ years in Program Management, Technical Program Management, or Engineering Project Management in a software/technology company.
Proven experience driving execution across multiple Engineering teams with interdependent deliverables, in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Track record coordinating cross-functional teams (Engineering, Product, QA, Customer Success, Customer Support, Sales/SE).
Strong stakeholder management — able to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority.
Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, and delivery/reporting tools.
Experience with release management, RCA/defect trend analysis, or engineering dashboards.

Good to Have

Technical background or experience working closely with engineers.
B2B SaaS / enterprise software experience.
Familiarity with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, or application architecture.
Experience with distributed/geographically diverse teams.
PMP, SAFe, or Scrum Master certification.
Strong analytical skills and comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities.

Success in This Role

Roadmap and sprint delivery become measurably more predictable.
Customer-impacting issues resolve faster, with clear ownership and tracking.
Recurring defects decline through consistent RCA follow-through.
Engineering, Customer Support, Product, CSM, and SE teams report better visibility and alignment.

jobs.title: Program Manager (CJIS Compliance)
jobs.description:
There is only one city in the country that can say it is the Nation’s Capital – Washington, D.C.  Given that distinction, the Metropolitan Police Department is the premiere law enforcement organization in the city. We receive over 22 million visitors a year, have almost 700,000 residents, and 21,000 private business. The Department consists of more than 4,200 members: approximately 3,550 sworn members and over 650 civilian employees. We are one of the most diverse and highly trained departments in the country.  We have the honor of safeguarding and protecting not only our nation’s residents, but also people from all over the world.

The Metropolitan Police Department (MPD) offers an attractive benefits package.  The benefits package includes competitive compensation, health insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability and life insurance, as well a strong retirement benefit and saving options. Employees are also eligible for our employer contributed 401a plan after one year of employment. Additional perks such as discounts on wireless carriers, gym memberships, amusement park tickets and much more! Additional information can be found at: DCHR Benefits

This position is located in the Metropolitan Police Department (MPD), Technical Services Bureau (TSB), Technology Division (TD). Applications Management Branch (AMB). The (TSB) oversees all information technology services, as well as records management, fleet services and evidence control of the IT component of the bureau include software development, data quality and compliance, business application development, and information technology program management. The incumbent works under the general supervision of the Director, Business Applications, who establishes broad program, policy priorities, and identifies overall resources available. The incumbent independently plans, organizes and carries out major assignments; determines the methods and approaches to be used; coordinates with internal and external resources and resolves complex technical, operational, compliance, and policy issues.

The Incumbent Will Be Responsible For The Following

Serving as MPD’s senior technical authority and principal advisor for CJIS compliance, cybersecurity governance, and Criminal Justice Information protection.

Providing leadership and oversight for MPD’s compliance with the FBI CJIS Security Policy and all applicable federal, District of Columbia, and MPD cybersecurity requirements. Serves as MPD’s primary authority and point of contact on CJIS compliance matters. Plans, directs, and evaluates complex cybersecurity, CJIS compliance, and information systems security initiatives that affect MPD’s enterprise technology environment and public safety operations.

Developing, managing, and monitoring cybersecurity compliance strategies, project plans, timelines, budgets, risk registers, corrective action plans, and performance measures and reporting mechanisms. Ensures MPD systems, applications, vendor platforms, cloud services, and technology initiatives align with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity governance, risk management principles, and CJIS requirements.

Providing authoritative technical guidance on the implementation of CJIS security controls, including access controls, advanced authentication, encryption, auditing, logging, incident response, personnel security, media protection, system integrity, and secure information sharing. Leads internal and external audits, assessments inspections, and reviews conducted by CJIS Systems Agencies, federal oversight entities, District agencies, or other authorized bodies. Develops, tracks and manages corrective action plans to address audit findings, compliance gaps, cybersecurity weaknesses, and operational risks.

Conducting and overseeing risk assessments for systems, applications, vendor solutions, data-sharing arrangements, and cloud-based environments involving CJIS. Coordinates with Information Security Officers (ISOs) and CJIS Security Officers (CSOs), legal counsel, agency partners, and District public safety stakeholders to ensure secure and compliant system operations. Reviews proposed technology solutions, contracts, memoranda of understanding, interagency agreements, and data-sharing arrangements to identify cybersecurity, CJIS, privacy, and operational risks. Prepares and delivers executive briefings, policy recommendations, compliance reports, risk assessment and strategic recommendations to MPD leadership on cybersecurity posture, compliance risks, and mitigation strategies.

Performing other related duties as assigned.

Licensures, Certifications And Other Requirements

Possession of a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) Certification and/or experience working with state CJIS Systems Agency (CSA) is strongly preferred.

Education

Degree in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, or technology management or degree that provided a minimum of 24 semester hours in one or more of the fields identified above and required the development or adaptation of applications, systems or networks is required.

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, Public Administration, Criminal Justice, or related field is preferred.

Work Experience

Applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade (MSS - Grade 13), or its non-District equivalent, gained in either the public or private sector. Specialized experience includes but not limited to: overseeing and applying Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) technical security controls and cybersecurity compliance audit standards; network security architecture, encryption protocols, VPN technologies, and identity access management. Experience in managing and developing new approaches, methods or procedures in data gathering and analysis; and interpreting legal and regulatory language into operational controls. Communication skills to express ideas clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing; to present recommendations and proposals; to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees and government officials; and to write and edit reports, proposals, policies, procedures, and recommendations and the ability to provide training and supervise a team.

One Year Of Prior Management/leadership Experience Is Strongly Preferred.

Work Environment

Work location is in an office environment.  Work is sedentary and may require walking and standing in conjunction with travel and attendance at meeting and conferences away from the work site and carrying light items, such as laptops, papers, books, small parts, and driving an automobile.

Other Significant Factors

Position Designation:

The Metropolitan Police Department is a 24-hour, 7 days a week operation. This position is considered “ emergency
” per DPM Chapter 12. An emergency employee must report to or remain at work if activated, during a declared emergency.

Position Suitability

This position is deemed as “Security Sensitive” pursuant to Chapter 4 of the D.C. Personnel Regulations, in addition to the general suitability screening and criminal background check (pre-employment and periodic), individuals may be subject to the following checks and tests:

Traffic record check (as applicable);

Pre-employment drug and alcohol test (as applicable);

Consumer credit check (as applicable);

Reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol test;

Random drug and alcohol test;

Return to duty or follow-up drug and alcohol test; and

Post-accident or incident drug and alcohol test.

MSS At Will Employment Statement

This position is “At Will”. At will employment applies to the Management Supervisory Service (MSS). All positions and appointments in the MSS serve at the pleasure of the appointing authority and may be terminated at any time with or without cause. This position is not in a collective bargaining unit.

Residency Preference

Applicants claiming “Residency Preference” will be required to maintain residency in the District of Columbia for a minimum of seven (7) years. Failure to do so may result in forfeiture of employment.

If the position you are applying for is in the Career, Management Supervisory, or Educational Service at an annual salary of one hundred fifty thousand dollars ($150,000) or more, you must establish residency in the District of Columbia within one hundred eighty (180) days of the effective date of the appointment and continue to maintain residency within the District of Columbia throughout the duration of the appointment.

About The Role

Canadian Blood Services is looking for a Regular, full-time Program Manager
to join the Infrastructure Program within the Network & Collections Transformation team.

In this role, you will be responsible for planning, managing, and supporting the delivery of new, operationally ready facilities with validated systems and equipment, and with appropriate regulatory approvals and licenses in place. You will play an integral role by leading a small team implementing multiple concurrent initiatives; developing and implementing program dashboards, roadmaps and other materials to support long-term program planning and corporate reporting; and supporting the establishment of governance and operational structures related to national design standards.

Formula for Success

Leveraging your project and program management experience, you will lead or participate in the delivery of several multi-year projects according to established cost and time parameters, where stakeholder management and change management are critical considerations.
Utilizing your collaboration skills, you will work with multiple teams and steering committees, while leveraging your leadership and engagement skills to oversee, support and direct project team members in staying engaged with the plan and effectively accomplishing the goals and objectives of the projects being delivered.
Drawing on your leadership experience, you will monitor implementation activities, including those related to equipment device ordering, validation and deployment, provide regular status updates to all key partners and leadership, and identify opportunities for process improvement and program maturation.
Drawing on your decision-making expertise, you will make decisions that impact project deliverables, costs, and timelines, which will impact other business areas.
Your risk management expertise will be utilized to identify, monitor, and mitigate substantial risks, with implications beyond the project.
Utilizing your communication and teamwork skills, you will intervene in sensitive or complex stakeholder communications, remove barriers, and facilitate change management.
Drawing on your management experience, you will develop and implement new tools, templates, dashboards and other technologies to support the program.

Desired Education And Skills

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, science or equivalent.
7+ years experience managing complex projects with large teams, budgets, and multiple stakeholders at an executive level.
Completed training in project management such as PRINCE2, PMP, or Agile Scrum Master is an asset.
Project Management Certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is an asset.
Subject matter expertise relevant to the nature of the projects assigned (i.e., IT, quality, science, engineering, etc.)
Experience managing new product or process introduction in the regulated environment is an asset.
Experience managing and implementing process change within a unionized workforce environment is an asset.
Experience navigating competing priorities and deadlines on complex or sensitive projects, including developing and maintaining project documents and presenting in an executive setting.
Experience in Agile teams is an asset.
Experience developing and maintaining project documents and presenting in an executive setting.
Ability to build good relationships, to assign, coordinate and manage the project activities of team members.
Proficiency with software tools including Microsoft Project Professional (MSPO), Power BI is an asset.

Description

Ledcor Technical Services is undergoing rapid growth, and we are seeking Senior Project Managers with the leadership experience and technical expertise to oversee and deliver complex, high‑impact telecom infrastructure projects.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving the successful execution of major initiatives—including fiber optic deployments, wireless infrastructure builds, and large‑scale network upgrades. You will be responsible for ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within scope and budget, and in alignment with the industry's highest quality and safety standards. In this senior‑level capacity, you will provide strategic direction, lead cross‑functional teams, optimize operational performance, and contribute to a culture built on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Join our True-Blue team and help lead the development of the networks of tomorrow.

Essential Responsibilities:

Champion and uphold Ledcor’s safety-first culture, ensuring all safety and environmental standards are met or exceeded on telecom construction sites
Lead the planning and execution of large-scale telecommunications projects, including fiber deployments, small cell installations, and wireless tower builds
Manage risk management, permitting, and client communications throughout the project lifecycle
Lead the identification and pursuit of new telecom project opportunities
Oversee the project scheduling, budgeting, and resource allocation using industry-standard tools and methodologies
Lead the implementation of the Project Quality Plan (PQP) and ensure compliance with telecom construction standards and specifications
Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials and services
Negotiate contract execution and change order management
Help establish and manage project systems, including cost tracking, reporting, and documentation

Qualifications:

8+ years of telecom or utility construction project management experience, with a proven track record of leading large, complex infrastructure builds
Education in Construction Management, Telecommunications, Engineering, or a related field (bachelor’s degree preferred; diploma or technical training accepted)
Strong understanding of telecom construction methods, permitting processes, and industry standards (e.g., NESC, NEC, local codes)
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage subcontractors, and communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders
Experience with contract negotiation, cost control, and scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or similar) is a plus

Working Conditions:

This position is primarily hybrid. Remote work may be considered for highly qualified candidates based on experience, location, and business needs.

Compensation
