jobs.description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

In BDO Consulting we may look for opportunities to engage you on projects across businesses.

BDO Digital
is looking for a Data Analytics/ Data Engineer New Grad
to join our growing client-facing team on a full-time permanent basis. This is a net new role and responsibilities will include:

Play an integral role in our delivery practice as we execute on enterprise level client engagements through our various industry specializations
Engage directly with clients and drive the implementation and successful end user experience of analytics solutions; execute on engagements and collaborate with the client and delivery team to ensure that any applicable milestones and deliverables are met on time and on budget
Design and develop industry-specific data models for client projects in industries such as Natural Resources, Finance, Manufacturing and Distribution, and Retail
Work with other engineers to enhance data models and improve data query efficiency; create complex data queries to facilitate ad hoc and exploratory analytics
Build real-time data capture and transformation functionality across all products and build out technology stack for Business Intelligence and Data Warehouse
Clean data: review for data inconsistencies and identify opportunities to improve data collection process; Wrangle/Munge data: transform or map data from one raw data form into another format with the intent of making it more appropriate and valuable for analytics
Develop, construct, test and maintain architectures such as databases and large-scale data processing systems; design, construct, install, test and maintain highly scalable data management systems
Employ a variety of languages and tools (e.g. scripting languages) to marry systems together
Build or recommend data visualization tools and business intelligence tools such as interactive dashboards and automated reports, to enable leaders to make swift, fact-based decisions
Remain up to date of development technologies, both current and future in order to deliver state-of-the-art Analytics solutions for our customers

How do we define success for your role?

You demonstrate BDO's core values through all aspect of your work: Integrity, Respect and Collaboration
You understand your client’s industry, challenges, and opportunities; client describe you as positive, professional, and delivering high quality work
You identify, recommend, and are focused on effective service delivery to your clients
You share in an inclusive and engaging work environment that develops, retains & attracts talent
You actively participate in the adoption of digital tools and strategies to drive an innovative workplace
You grow your expertise through learning and professional development.

Your Experience And Education

Post-secondary education in engineering or computer science or equivalent work experience
Good experience working with Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory and Azure Data Lake
Programming experience in Python
Strong attention to the quality of work delivered (attention to detail)
Able to adapt quickly to changing client requirements
The following are considered and asset:
Experience using the Apache Hadoop ecosystem (Spark, Data Lake, Hive, HDFS, Impala) to tackle "big data" problems
Knowledge of ETL, ELT, Lambda and Kappa data architectures
Experience with the Microsoft SQL Server Analytics stack including: Core SQL, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases
Knowledge of Continuous Integration and Source Control systems (e.g. Gradle, Maven, Bamboo, TeamCity, Git)
Data Visualization experience in Power BI, Tableau, or similar
Exposure to data science, machine learning or statistics
Some experience using Docker

The expected range of compensation for this role is $60,000 to $92,000.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter:
We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts:
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.

All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

jobs.title: County Facilities Security Manager
jobs.description:
The County Executive’s Office is seeking qualified candidates for the position of County Facilities Security Manager.

The County Facilities Security Manager is responsible for supervising and coordinating security operations across five County buildings at County Center and at other County facilities. This role includes managing security agreements, collaborating with law enforcement agencies such as the Sheriff’s Office concerning the Hall of Justice and County Center campus security, and overseeing security infrastructure including surveillance camera systems. The County Facilities Security Manager ensures compliance with security policies that are consistent with industry best practices and maintains safe environments within all assigned facilities.

This position carries full supervisory authority over security staff and vendors, manages security contracts and budgets, engages in strategic security planning and policy development, and collaborates extensively with law enforcement agencies. The role requires advanced knowledge of security strategies, law enforcement coordination, management principles, and contract administration to ensure secure, compliant, and efficient facility operations across the County.

This classification is distinct from law enforcement roles in that it is a civilian management position without peace officer status. The Building Security Manager serves to provide leadership and administrative oversight ensuring effective security management within the County’s public buildings and facilities.

Examples Of Duties

Duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Manage security agreements and contracts for multiple County buildings.
Collaborate with the Sheriff’s Office and other law enforcement agencies regarding the security of the Hall of Justice and other facilities.
Oversee installation, operation, and maintenance of surveillance camera systems and other security technologies at County Center and additional facilities.
Test and conduct security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and recommend improvements.
Manage relationships with third-party security vendors and ensure compliance with security requirements.
Develop, schedule, and conduct safety and security training programs for County personnel, including active shooter response training.
Respond to security incidents and coordinate appropriate follow-up actions.
Supervise and evaluate security staff assigned to County facilities.
Prepare and maintain reports related to security operations, incidents, and compliance.
Participate in long-range planning for facility security enhancements and technology upgrades.
Coordinate emergency preparedness and response activities in collaboration with internal departments and external agencies.
Perform related duties as assigned.

Ideal Candidate

The County Executive’s Office is seeking individuals who demonstrate strong character, professionalism, and a genuine commitment to public service.

Ideal candidates will possess the following characteristics:

Integrity, Ethical Judgment, and Political Astuteness – Demonstrates honesty, accountability, and sound decision-making while maintaining the highest ethical standards.
Commitment to Public Service – Shows a genuine desire to serve others and improve the safety and well-being of the community.
Strong Communication Skills – Communicates effectively both verbally and in writing and interacts professionally with the public, County employees, and the County Executive team.
Emotional Intelligence and Sound Judgment – Remains calm and composed and makes good decisions in stressful or rapidly evolving situations.
Teamwork and Collaboration – Works effectively with others and contributes positively to a professional team environment.
Accountability and Initiative – Demonstrates responsibility, reliability, and self-motivation.
Cultural Awareness and Community Engagement – Values and respects the diverse communities served by the County of San Mateo.

This is a limited-term position:
Limited-term positions are full-time, fully benefited, temporary positions. This current position is funded for up to two years, depending on the department’s needs. Limited Term employees receive medical and dental benefits, like regular employees, and a defined contribution retirement plan (401-A).

Information for current County employees:
Current and regular County of San Mateo Employees who are interested in this assignment must submit application materials and compete in the selection process. If you are successful in the selection process and are being considered for the assignment, HR will work directly with you and/or your department for options. Please note there is no guarantee that you will be allowed by your department to rotate into this assignment nor is your department obligated to allow you to take on this assignment.

If you are chosen for the assignment, it is considered a work-out-of-class or development opportunity. You remain a full-time, regular employee “on loan” to the County Executive’s Office for the duration of the assignment.

The salary range for this position is "as is" and non-negotiable.

Qualifications

Experience and Education:

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge and skills is qualifying. A typical way to qualify is:

Three to five years of extensive security management experience, including significant supervisory responsibilities and contract administration.

Professional certifications such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP) or Physical Security Professional (PSP) from ASIS International are desirable.

Knowledge of:

Principles and practices of managing security operations for public buildings.
Security measures and protocols related to protection of personnel, property, and visitors.
Methods and procedures used in criminal and incident investigations.
Contract administration and vendor management in the context of security services.
Laws, regulations, and industry standards applicable to building security and safety.
Active shooter response planning and emergency preparedness procedures.
Security technology systems including surveillance camera operations and maintenance.
Public administration principles, including supervision, training, and budgeting.
Effective communication techniques for diverse audiences.
Criminal Justice, Public Administration, Business, or a closely related field.

Skill/Ability to:

Manage and coordinate multi-facility security programs effectively.
Collaborate and liaise with law enforcement and other agencies.
Plan and deliver security training and awareness sessions.
Analyze security risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
Lead, supervise, and develop security personnel and vendors.
Evaluate security incidents and recommend preventative measures.
Communicate clearly and professionally both orally and in writing with diverse stakeholders.
Implement and monitor compliance with security policies and contractual agreements.

Application/Examination

This is an Open recruitment. Anyone may apply.

The examination process will consist of an application screening (weight: pass/fail) based on the candidates' application and responses to the supplemental questions. Candidates who pass the application screening will be invited to a panel interview (weight: 100%) which may include a brief writing exercise given immediately prior to the interview.

Depending on the number of applicants, an application appraisal of education and experience may be used in place of other examinations or further evaluation of work experience may be conducted to group applicants by level of qualification. All applicants who meet the minimum qualifications are not guaranteed advancement through any subsequent phase of the examination.

As a Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst, you will help strengthen the operational engine supporting a global Commercial organization in a high-growth SaaS environment. You will combine data analysis, process design, and cross-functional execution to improve commercial productivity and decision-making. The role spans revenue planning, performance reporting, CRM governance, Deal Desk operations, and broader go-to-market initiatives. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, Finance, and Commercial leadership to turn complex business questions into actionable insights. You will also explore AI-powered workflows and automation opportunities to make Revenue Operations more efficient and scalable. This is an ideal opportunity for an analytical and operational professional who enjoys creating structure, solving ambiguous problems, and driving continuous improvement.

Accountabilities

Support revenue planning, reporting, and analysis across territories, quotas, and key performance indicators, covering different functions, regions, segments, and verticals.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that provide visibility into commercial productivity and performance.
Analyze commercial performance, including win/loss trends, funnel performance, and pipeline health, and translate business questions into data analysis, insights, and actionable recommendations.
Develop AI agents, skills, and workflows that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Revenue Operations, including data analysis, process development, and reporting.
Support initiatives designed to improve commercial effectiveness and productivity, including lead routing, pipeline generation, and sales process improvements.
Execute Deal Desk workflows by structuring, reviewing, and approving non-standard deals in partnership with Sales and Finance.
Identify opportunities to improve and streamline Deal Desk processes and workflows.
Oversee CRM data quality, field governance, and audit processes to maintain reliable commercial data.
Design, improve, and operationalize scalable business processes and standard operating procedures.
Contribute to change management and enablement initiatives, including the development of training materials and process documentation.
Partner with Commercial leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to identify operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making and operational excellence across the Commercial organization.

Requirements

3+ years of experience in Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations, Go-to-Market Operations, or a closely related function, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.
Eastern or Central U.S. time zone preferred to support collaboration with a global team.
Demonstrated ability to design, improve, and operationalize business processes at scale.
Familiarity with Salesforce, CPQ tools, and other go-to-market platforms such as Salesloft, ZoomInfo, Ringlead, and Chamelio.
Experience using AI assistants such as Claude to accelerate Revenue Operations workflows, including the development of skills, workflows, and dashboards.
Strong analytical capabilities with advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence presenting data and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and Commercial leadership.
Comfortable working through ambiguity and adapting to rapidly changing priorities in a high-growth environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Eagerness to learn, adaptability, and a strong commitment to operational excellence.
Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, Finance, and other teams.
Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on practical, scalable solutions.

Equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units.
Flexible work hours.
Opportunity to work from anywhere.
Full suite of health insurance options.
Generous paid time off.

Business Resource Groups supporting employee connection and inclusion.

jobs.title: Business Analyst 3
jobs.description:
THE POSITION

As a Business Analyst 3 with the Municipal Retirement System, you will support essential reporting tools that help guide important retirement services. This role brings you into collaboration with business and technical teams to improve data resources. You will play a key part in strengthening reporting accuracy and system performance. Join this team and help move critical work forward every day.

DESCRIPTION OF WORK

This position focuses on reporting development, data analysis, and support of complex information systems. The role works with business and technical staff to strengthen reporting processes and resolve system issues. As a Business Analyst 3, you will perform the following duties:

Requirements Analysis: Identify reporting and data needs and translate them into system requirements
Report Development: Build and update dashboards, queries, and reporting tools with approved technologies
Data Evaluation: Review data outputs to confirm accuracy and locate inconsistencies
System Coordination: Support system changes and collaborate with technical staff to address issues
Testing Support: Prepare testing materials and assist business users during system updates
User Assistance: Provide training and guidance on reporting solutions and applications

Interested in learning more? Additional details regarding this position can be found in the position description .

Work Schedule and Additional Information:

Full time employment, 37.5 hours per week.
Work hours are 7:45 AM to 4:15 PM, Monday - Friday, with a 60 minute lunch.
Telework: You may have the opportunity to work from home (telework) part-time, up to 2 days per week after successful completion of the training period. In order to telework, you must have a securely configured high-speed internet connection and work from an approved location inside Pennsylvania. If you are unable to telework, you will have the option to report to the headquarters office in Harrisburg, PA. The ability to telework is subject to change at any time. Additional details may be provided during the interview.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Higher Education and Research
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for an expert Technical Program Manager to scale strategic programs across the global higher education and research ecosystem. In this role, you will lead university engagement, curriculum adoption, and grant operations that help researchers, faculty, and students build with NVIDIA advanced computing platforms, publicly available models, and CUDA-X libraries. Work across NVIDIA and with leading academic institutions around the world to turn high-impact collaborations into repeatable, measurable programs

What You'll Be Doing

Define strategy, governance, operational performance indicators, success metrics, and execution models.
Scale NVIDIA Tech Days for universities as a repeatable global program, including institution prioritization, content development, execution standards, measurement, and continuous improvement.
Support curriculum integration collaborations with leading universities and faculty advocates to incorporate NVIDIA open models, learning content, and guest speakers into undergraduate and graduate coursework, ensuring students gain early access and exposure to open-source models and computing platform technologies.
Coordinate strategic academic investments, including supporting operations for discrete university lab sponsorships and NVIDIA’s education rebate program.
Collaborate with and be supported by NVIDIA field staff—including Developer Relations (DevRel), Account Managers, and Solution Architects—to ensure flawless, consistent, and excellent program execution globally. Collaborate internally with NVIDIA Developer Programs, Deep Learning Institute, and Product teams to bring the best of NVIDIA to lighthouse universities.
Synthesize insights from faculty, researchers, and students to help build future NVIDIA platforms, libraries, and educational content.
Track and communicate outcomes, including program reach, library adoption, open-source contributions, paper citations, and infrastructure utilization. Identify ecosystem gaps, test new program concepts, and scale successful pilots across regions and research domains.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree in business, program management, education, public policy, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of program or project management experience
Extensive experience in product or program management, strategic operations, partnerships, or grant administration within technology, higher education, research, or a comparable environment.
Demonstrated success leading sophisticated, cross-functional programs spanning multiple teams, timelines, dependencies, and global regions. Proven track record to develop, operationalize, and scale new processes and initiatives across organizations and geographies.
Experience working with universities, academic faculty and researchers, student education programs, or sponsored research, with a practical understanding of how institutions evaluate and adopt technology.
Strong operational excellence, including program governance, strategic execution, performance metrics, and executive-level reporting.
Success also requires collaborating across technical and non-technical teams, influencing partners without direct authority, and translating sophisticated concepts into clear, actionable plans.
Outstanding communication skills, including executive-facing communications, are critical. At NVIDIA, successful candidates are collaborative, proactive, and able to adapt quickly while managing competing priorities.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Familiarity with AI and machine learning, accelerated computing, open models, and NVIDIA technologies such as CUDA-X libraries will give us an edge. Likewise, experience developing curriculum integrations, teaching kits, or reusable technical enablement for faculty and students is a major plus! Moreover, the following will move you to front of the pack.
Post-graduate qualification in business, education, computer science, engineering, or a comparable area, or equivalent experience.
Experience using data, automation, or AI tools to improve program execution, reporting, and cross-NVIDIA communication.
Experience working across multiple regions and university systems.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 136,000 USD - 212,750 USD for Level 3, and 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 19, 2026.

jobs.title: RESIDENTIAL PROGRAM MANAGER – ADULT RESIDENTIAL SERVICES
jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

RESIDENTIAL PROGRAM MANAGER – ADULT RESIDENTIAL PROGRAM

Full-Time, Salary: $66,300 - $75,000/year

Make a Real Difference Every Day:
Do you want a career where you directly impact lives, experiencing the deep fulfillment that comes from helping others and a strong sense of purpose?

Shifts Available:
Full-time plus on-call 24/7 for emergencies and callouts

About Brightway Living & Learning:
Brightway Living & Learning is a premier non-profit provider of human services on Long Island, including educational, residential, day habilitation, and vocational programs. Building on a 65-year legacy as the Developmental Disabilities Institute (DDI), Brightway supports over 1,600 children and adults with autism and other developmental disabilities through a full continuum of care. By employing persistence, adaptability, and the power of behavioral science, Brightway’s dedicated professionals enable individuals to grow, learn, and meet milestones at their own pace. Discover more about our mission and our "All Ways Forward" approach at brightwayny.org.

The Role:
As a Residential Program Manager, you will play a vital role in supporting individuals with disabilities in their daily lives at our Spring Meadow & Sagamore houses. You will work closely with them and your employees, managing all of the day-to-day operations of the residence. This is a truly rewarding opportunity to build meaningful relationships and make a tangible difference.

What You'll Do

Handle employment and staffing needs for your residence, including hiring, performance evaluations, and supervision of staff, as well as submission of required payroll data.
Maintain knowledge of Emergency Procedures and accurate implementation of procedures in handling crisis situations as they arise.
Train new staff to work with individual(s) served
Ensure all staff have current certifications in all areas (TB, AMAP, CPR, etc.) and provide annual recertification trainings.
Maintain staff schedule, run staff meetings, participate in Interdisciplinary Team Meetings.
Write and implement Annual Program Plan; write formal goals, protocols.
Participate in the writing and implementation of Behavior Plans, and all other components of the Annual Plan (i.e., medical, nutrition, fitness, socialization, etc.).
Evaluate monthly progress as related to short term objectives and formulation of new objectives based on level attained.
Accompany individuals on medical appointments.
Complete Operating Checklist, and all budgetary processes (i.e., petty cash, OTPS, etc.)
Responsible for bookkeeping for individuals: Nami payments, SSI, tax refunds, etc.
Coordinate efforts in all areas: Psychology, Nutrition/Fitness, Nursing, Day Hab and Residential, and Service Coordination.
Complete incident reports and SCIP-R reports as necessary, review for accuracy, and submit monthly
Interface with parents and facilitate their involvement with their son/daughter’s program plan.
Advocate for individuals served and implement new programming ideas, exploring the individuals’ interests.
24-hour on call for staffing/emergency problems
Performs all job functions of the community instructor as needed

What You Need For The Role

High School Diploma, BA/BS preferred
Two years experience working with developmentally disabled adults
Valid NYS driver’s license, preferred [NOTE: Positions for non-approved drivers are NOT available in all programs and are based on program needs.]*
Working knowledge of Applied Behavior Analysis and Positive Behavioral Support
Must be able to modify the area to secure the safety of the adults i.e. move/push tables and other heavy objects up to 20 lbs.
Must be able to lift/move/carry 20 lbs.
Must be able to run after an individual up to 500 feet
Must be able to run to a program in need up to 500 feet
Must be able to kneel, twist and bend
Must be able to respond to fire alarms
Must be able to perform all physical SCIP techniques

Why You'll Love This Job

Build Meaningful Relationships: Develop strong connections with individuals and their families.
Learn and Grow: Benefit from ongoing training and professional development.
Be Part of a Supportive Team: Work with passionate and dedicated colleagues.
Experience Job Satisfaction: Feel a deep sense of accomplishment knowing your work matters.
Exceptional Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off.

Here’s How We Support You

Comprehensive Paid Training: Get the skills you need to succeed.
Exceptional Benefits: Including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, FSA, and EAP.
Retirement Security: 403(b) retirement plan.
Invest in Your Future: Tuition reimbursement opportunities.
Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within Brightway Living & Learning.
And More: Paid time off and other valuable benefits!

If You Are

Empathic, compassionate, and patient
Positive, energetic, and enthusiastic
A good communicator and team player
Passionate about making a difference

Then, we encourage you to apply and join the Brightway Living & Learning team!

When you join our team, you become part of the Brightway Living & Learning Family! Click here to watch our video to find out more about the Brightway Living & Learning Family.

Brightway Living & Learning is committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees without regard to actual or perceived race, color, sex, pregnancy, reproductive decision making, gender expression or identity, national origin, disability, military status, creed, religion, age, sexual orientation, marital status, genetic information, status as a victim of domestic violence or any other group protected by federal, state or local law. We are committed to creating a deep sense of belonging and a culture where all applicants and employees feel welcomed, valued and respected. We are people inspired by purpose

B&A is seeking a skilled Business Analyst to support the modernization of the organization’s asset management solution. This initiative will implement the ServiceNow IT Asset Management (ITAM) module to replace the legacy OpenText Asset Manager system. The new solution will enhance asset visibility, improve lifecycle tracking, and strengthen audit compliance while integrating seamlessly with existing ServiceNow modules, including IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), CMDB, Security Operations, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC).

The Business Analyst will serve as the bridge between stakeholders and the technical team, ensuring business needs are accurately captured, documented, and translated into requirements for the ITAM solution. This role requires strong analytical skills, ServiceNow platform experience, and exceptional interpersonal communication to facilitate collaboration across diverse stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Partner with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business needs for the ServiceNow ITAM implementation and modernization effort.
Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for the ITAM solution.
Conduct business process and system analysis, design, improvement, and implementation efforts to align with modernization goals.
Lead requirements workshops, stakeholder interviews, and group facilitation sessions to ensure comprehensive knowledge transfer and alignment.
Analyze and map current asset management processes, identifying opportunities for improvement and alignment with ServiceNow ITAM best practices.
Collaborate with technical teams to validate requirements, track development progress, and support solution design decisions.
Assist in testing, validation, and user acceptance efforts to ensure the ITAM solution meets asset visibility, lifecycle tracking, and audit compliance objectives.
Maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor and ensuring transparency throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide input into training materials, user guides, and adoption strategies to support successful implementation.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
10+ years of relevant experience

Required Skills

Proven experience working as a Business Analyst on ServiceNow projects, with exposure to ITAM or related modules (ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, GRC, Security Ops).
Advanced experience in business process and system analysis, design, improvement, and implementation.
Demonstrated ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements and solutions.
Experience conducting group facilitation, stakeholder interviews, and other knowledge transfer activities.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across technical and business teams.
Strong organizational and documentation skills, with proficiency in requirements management tools and practices.
Familiarity with both Agile and Traditional project delivery methodologies.

Desired Skills

The Project Manager I is responsible for managing construction projects from award through closeout while ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with contract requirements and company standards. This role oversees project planning, budgeting, scheduling, subcontractor coordination, client communication, and financial performance. The Project Manager I partners closely with Superintendents, Foremen, Estimating, Accounting, and Executive Leadership to ensure successful project execution.

Manage assigned construction projects from project award through final closeout.
Develop project budgets, schedules, forecasts, and cash flow projections.
Review and interpret project plans, specifications, and contract documents.
Oversee subcontractor procurement, contract execution, and performance.
Manage project cost tracking, change orders, and financial reporting.
Coordinate project scheduling, material procurement, and equipment needs.
Serve as the primary point of contact with owners, inspectors, engineers, and subcontractors.
Partner with Superintendents to ensure jobsite productivity, safety compliance, and quality control.
Review and approve project billing, progress payments, and job cost reports.
Manage RFIs, submittals, change requests, and contract modifications.
Conduct project meetings, job walks, and stakeholder coordination meetings.
Support project risk management, issue resolution, and claims avoidance.
Ensure compliance with company safety standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate, organized, and complete project documentation.
Support project closeout including as-builts, warranties, final billing, and turnover documentation.
Maintain confidentiality of project financials, contracts, and company business information.
Performs other related duties as required or assigned. Responsibilities may be modified or added based on operational needs and business priorities.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
Equivalent construction and project management experience may be substituted.

Experience

5–8 years of progressive construction, utilities, or civil project management experience required.
Experience managing underground utilities, wet utilities, or civil infrastructure projects strongly preferred.

OSHA 30 preferred.
Valid California driver’s license required.

Skills

Strong knowledge of construction project management processes and job cost control.
Strong understanding of plans, specifications, and contract documents.
Strong budgeting, forecasting, and schedule management skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong problem-solving, leadership, and decision-making abilities.

Working closely with executive leadership, engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and major customers, you will turn technical and market insights into high-impact product capabilities. You will combine deep Salesforce expertise with hands-on product management, from customer discovery and roadmap definition through delivery and release. Accountabilities

Identify opportunities within the Salesforce ecosystem to create new product categories, address customer needs, and expand market opportunities.

Intellectual curiosity, independent judgment, strong ownership, and a bias toward action.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager | Real Estate
new_jobs.description:
About us

IMSOLD Agency is the agency arm of an AI-first venture studio. We don't run campaigns for clients and hand over a report — we build and operate brands end to end: research, creative, funnels, media buying, tech, and the teams that run them. Our portfolio spans health, wellness, B2B software, and real estate across the US, Europe, and the Middle East. This role sits on our Dubai real estate lead-generation account — a fast-moving operation connecting property owners and investors with licensed Dubai real estate professionals.

About the role

You orchestrate the complete marketing flow of the brand — from verified research foundations to a running content calendar — then hand off to production, which runs on our proprietary operations platform. You do not produce the work. Specialist teams handle research, copywriting, design, video, publishing, and legal review. Your job is rarer: to see the whole machine, verify that every input exists and is sound before work starts, spot the missing dependency before it breaks something downstream, and keep a dozen specialists in time. Six verbs describe the day-to-day: verify → chase → assemble → agree → build → hand off. 

What you'll do

Verify the brand's marketing foundations — market and competitor research, audience definitions, messaging inputs, legal constraints — and trigger the right specialist team when a layer is missing or below the bar
Assemble all verified inputs into one content plan for the brand 
Agree the content rhythm — channels, campaign mix, volume — directly with the brand's leadership
Build the content calendar so that every slot has its creative, caption, call-to-action, and a destination that actually exists
Hand off cleanly to production and keep the machine flowing: chase blockers, reconcile numbers, route every creative through compliance review before launch
Quality-control what comes back: catch contradictions, impossible numbers, and unsourced claims before they reach anyone downstream

What we're looking for

3+ years running performance-marketing, direct-response, or growth projects — owning the system, not just executing tasks in it
Hands-on familiarity with paid social funnels (Meta especially): you don't have to be the media buyer, but you must understand CPMs, CTR, CPL, and funnel math well enough to manage one
Proven ability to orchestrate a team of specialists to ship on deadline — and to tell someone their work is broken when it is
An instinct for dependencies: you naturally order work by what must exist first, and you treat "done" as something to verify, not something to accept
Fluent, precise written English — this is an async, remote, documentation-heavy environment 

Real estate experience — a strong plus, in this order

Dubai / UAE property market experience:
You've marketed in or to the Dubai real estate market — brokerage marketing, property portals or proptech, developer marketing, or lead generation for UAE realtors — and you know its advertising rules and market dynamics first-hand.
Property-market experience
anywhere You've run marketing operations or lead generation in any serious property market. The instincts transfer; the Dubai specifics are teachable.
Also welcome No property background
— but a world-class operator If you've orchestrated complex marketing systems in other industries and everything above describes you, we still want to hear from you. We hire the best operator in the pool. 

What this role is not

Not a real estate sales role — no transactions, no client calls, no commissions
Not a content-production role — you won't write scripts, design, or edit video
Not a media-buying role — specialists run the ads; you run the flow

What we offer

Fully remote work with high autonomy and high standards — you'll be trusted to run things, and held to the results
A documented, systemized operation: you inherit a complete written playbook, not chaos
Exposure to a multi-brand venture studio and a modern AI-native marketing stack
Long-term growth: strong moderators take on additional brands across the portfolio

How to apply

Send your CV to hr@imsold.com
with the subject line " Marketing Project Manager — Real Estate
" and include, in the body of your message:
In exactly five sentences: describe one system or process you personally kept on the rails — what its moving parts were, what broke most often, and how you caught it early
Your real estate / Dubai market experience, if any (be specific — markets, companies, campaigns)
Your monthly salary expectation and earliest start date

(Applications that skip the five-sentence answer will not be reviewed — following the instruction is part of the test. Shortlisted candidates complete a recorded 20–25 minute first-line interview conducted by our AI interviewer, followed by a live assessment session and a paid trial task.)

new_jobs.title: Structural Engineer - Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Structural Engineer - Project Manager based in Canada.

This is a senior engineering and project leadership opportunity focused on delivering structural projects from concept through completion. You will combine hands-on structural engineering expertise with ownership of project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, and client relationships. The role involves close coordination with architects, consultants, contractors, fabricators, detailers, and erectors across multidisciplinary project teams. You will provide technical oversight while ensuring designs, calculations, drawings, and specifications meet applicable codes, standards, and quality expectations. Strong commercial awareness will be important when balancing engineering requirements with constructability, timelines, budgets, and client priorities. The position is well suited to a proactive professional who enjoys managing multiple projects and taking ownership of successful delivery. It also offers opportunities to develop technical leadership, project management, and client-facing expertise within a technology-enabled engineering environment.

Accountabilities

Lead structural engineering projects from kickoff through design, coordination, delivery, and final closeout, maintaining ownership of project outcomes.
Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, engineering hours, resources, deliverables, and risks while proactively addressing issues that could affect successful delivery.
Design, analyze, review, and provide technical oversight for structural systems, ensuring engineering work meets applicable codes, standards, and quality requirements.
Review structural calculations, drawings, specifications, and other technical deliverables for accuracy, constructability, quality, and compliance.
Lead communication with clients and stakeholders, coordinating effectively with architects, consultants, contractors, fabricators, detailers, erectors, and other project partners.
Coordinate structural engineering requirements with detailing, fabrication, erection, architectural, and other disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage RFIs, design revisions, scope changes, technical challenges, and change orders, ensuring timely resolution and clear documentation.
Lead project meetings and communicate project status, priorities, risks, decisions, and required actions clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
Support proposals, scopes of work, fee estimates, project schedules, resource planning, and other business development activities.
Build and maintain strong client relationships through responsive communication, technical credibility, and consistent project delivery.
Mentor junior engineers and technical staff while promoting technical quality, efficiency, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
Apply structural engineering expertise to projects designed to Canadian CISC standards, with opportunities to support projects using AISC standards through U.S. operations.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is considered an asset.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation in Canada or eligibility for professional registration.
Minimum of 4 years of structural engineering experience, including demonstrated project coordination or project management responsibilities.
Strong experience in structural steel design, fabrication, detailing, erection, and construction processes.
Solid knowledge of applicable Canadian building codes, structural design standards, materials, and engineering practices.
Knowledge of AISC standards and experience with U.S. structural steel projects is an asset.
Proven ability to manage project schedules, budgets, engineering resources, deliverables, priorities, and client expectations.
Strong understanding of constructability and the ability to balance technical requirements with project cost, schedule, fabrication, erection, and client needs.
Commercial awareness, including an understanding of project costs, engineering hours, schedules, scope management, and profitability.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build productive relationships with clients and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
Strong leadership, decision-making, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Highly proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively.
Experience working with architects, consultants, contractors, steel fabricators, detailers, and erectors is an asset.
Familiarity with Tekla Structural Designer, Excel, IDEA StatiCa, Bluebeam, RISA Suite, Revit, or RAM Connection is considered an asset.
Strong motivation to continue developing technical, leadership, and project management capabilities.
Must be legally eligible to work in Canada and able and willing to travel to the United States as required.

Benefits

Competitive annual salary of $110,000–$150,000, based on skills, experience, and contributions.
Annual bonus opportunities linked to individual and organizational performance.
Comprehensive benefits package supporting employee health and well-being.
Employer RRSP matching contributions to support long-term financial planning.
Generous personal days to promote work-life balance and time to recharge.
Professional development opportunities, including training, mentorship, and career-growth pathways.
Respectful, collaborative workplace culture focused on teamwork and employee appreciation.
Modern, technology-enabled company equipment to support effective remote work.
Regular team-building events and activities designed to strengthen collaboration and connections.
Remote work opportunity based in Canada, with travel to the United States as required.

new_jobs.title: Procurement Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

As a Direct Materials Productivity Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for driving productivity improvements and cost efficiencies in the direct materials supply chain. Your role will focus on optimizing procurement strategies, enhancing supplier performance, and ensuring the seamless flow of materials to support manufacturing and operational objectives. You will leverage your expertise in supply chain management and data analytics to identify opportunities for cost reduction and process enhancement, contributing directly to Honeywell’s competitive advantage and profitability.

You will report directly to the Senior Director Procurement for Process Automation and you’ll work out from one our India locations (Bangalore/Hyderabed/Pune) on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact Honeywell’s operational efficiency by leading initiatives that improve material cost productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen supplier partnerships. Your leadership will ensure that material availability aligns with production demands while maintaining cost targets and quality standards, thereby supporting the company’s overall business goals.

Your role also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end to end processes and project for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on task to be performed; and monitoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skills development, professional growth, and overall success.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement direct materials productivity strategies aligned with business objectives to drive cost savings and operational efficiencies.
Responsible for execution of productivity projects and achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets
Responsible for developing a pipeline of productivity projects working cross-functionally with strategic sourcing, factory operations, engineering, offering management and suppliers globally
Responsible for achieving the productivity targets for all the levers i.e. Negotiations, Value Engineering, Component Engineering, Rebates and Deflation with the objective of achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity targets
Analyze procurement data and supplier performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
Analyze spend receipts data and find opportunities for cost savings working closely with supplier sourcing leaders and procurement operations
Collaborate closely with procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to optimize material specifications, sourcing strategies, and inventory management.
Lead supplier engagement initiatives to improve cost competitiveness.
Manage cross-functional projects focused on waste reduction, process improvements, and supply chain optimization.
Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to direct materials productivity and cost savings to senior leadership.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain processes.
Support the development and deployment of procurement tools and technologies to improve data visibility and decision-making.
Mentor and develop team members to build capabilities in materials productivity and supply chain excellence.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
5+ years of relevant experience in direct materials productivity or supply chain management roles.
Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to driving change.
Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team environment.

WE VALUE

Proven experience in managing direct materials procurement and productivity within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and drive actionable insights.
Expertise in supplier management, contract negotiation, and cost reduction strategies.
Proficiency with ERP systems, procurement software, and data analysis tools.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing projects that deliver measurable productivity improvements.

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Since 1974, we’ve provided our Members with financial and business solutions to make running a business easier. Our flagship Trade Account offers instant credit with over 1600 Preferred Suppliers, simplified monthly expenses, and a generous rewards program.

We have a strong foundation in the automotive and machinery aftermarkets. Our vibrant community includes over 31,000 Members across Australia and New Zealand, from national franchises to your local family workshop. Last year, Capricorn facilitated nearly $4bn in sales with our Preferred Suppliers.

As Project Manager, you will manage the start-up, initiation and day-to-day management and governance of corporate projects and initiatives across the organisation but initially focused on supporting Capricorn’s Communications and Engagement team. The role supports tactical priorities and the Powering Forward 2030 Strategy by bringing structure, momentum and clear accountability to an increasing portfolio of work.

You will define scope, develop project plans and schedules, coordinate resources, manage budgets and risks, and keep stakeholders informed through clear reporting and governance. You will also monitor quality, evaluate outcomes and ensure agreed deliverables are achieved on time, within budget and to the required standard.

Your projects will include managing business-led initiatives and event programs such as Capricorn’s biennial Convention, Captivate, Gala Dinner and Trade Shows, as well as other initiatives currently planned by this team. What
you’ll bring

At least five years’ experience planning, leading and managing project teams consisting of committed project resources and leveraged BAU/Operational staff to achieve project outcomes within project tolerances.
A strong application of project management disciplines to ensure that typical project controls including risk, issue, dependency, resource, change and budgets are effectively monitored, managed and maintained, with clear documentation and reporting.

A little on life at Capricorn

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager (TPM) to drive cross-functional planning and execution for our Software programs. In this role, you will work closely with engineering leaders across software, hardware, science, and product to coordinate efforts from early concept through delivery to (literal!) launch. You will develop schedules and milestones, uncover gaps, flag risks, support resource planning, and ensure clear communication across stakeholders.

As a Software TPM, you’ll help teams stay aligned, unblock issues quickly, and deliver critical software capabilities that power Muon’s mission. You will provide the structure and process discipline required to scale our development efforts, while enabling teams to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, interdisciplinary environment.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

Program Planning & Roadmapping: Define objectives, scope, milestones, and success criteria in collaboration with engineering and product stakeholders.
Scheduling & Execution Management: Build and maintain project timelines, track dependencies, monitor progress, and adjust plans as priorities shift.
Risk & Issue Management: Identify risks early, coordinate mitigation plans, surface blockers, and drive timely resolution.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate collaboration across software, hardware, science, and product teams, ensuring aligned deliverables and clear handoffs.
Communication & Reporting: Provide concise, actionable updates to stakeholders and leadership on progress, changes, risks, and decisions.
Process & Continuous Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in workflows, propose improvements, and help implement better practices and tools.
Resource & Capacity Planning: Assist in forecasting resource needs, tracking capacity, and supporting prioritization and staffing decisions.
Release Planning & Readiness: Coordinate software releases, track readiness criteria, and communicate expectations to impacted teams.

Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated ability to establish and optimize software project management processes.
Strong technical background with knowledge of software development methods, tools, and infrastructure.
Proven ability to communicate effectively with diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience leading cross-functional planning, scheduling, and risk management across multiple teams.
Results-oriented mindset with a bias toward clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Excited to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with evolving priorities.

new_jobs.description:
The San Francisco Museum of Modern Art is one of the largest museums of modern and contemporary art in the United States and a thriving cultural center for the Bay Area. We cannot imagine life without art; it inspires and connects us every day. Now more than ever, these connections matter and are aligned with our values
.

Inclusive
: We strive to be a museum of many voices in dialogue.

Passionate
: We believe working with art is more than a job or trusteeship - it's a way of life.

Brave
: We are committed to approaching our work with courage and a sense of adventure, always ready to explore new perspectives.

Empathic
: We aim to act like a person, not an institution.

SFMOMA is a place for the infinitely curious to explore, support, and experience the art of our time. We believe that modern and contemporary art can influence the way we think, view the world, and embrace the many voices and perspectives around us. We aspire to foster an environment that elicits joy, nurtures a sense of belonging and purpose—where difference is seen as a strength, and every one is appreciated for their whole self.

Schedule
: Full Time, 35/hours per week, at least three days working onsite, occasional evenings and weekends required

The Program Manager, Audience Development & Engagement leads the strategy, development, and execution of programs designed to drive cultural relevance, engage diverse audiences, and deliver measurable audience growth.

This high-impact role creates broad-audience experiences that simultaneously generate revenue, enhance brand equity, and cultivate the next generation of SFMOMA visitors, with particular attention to audiences who may not see themselves as traditional museumgoers. The Program Manager seeks out unexpected partnerships, formats, and moments that help new audiences feel SFMOMA's relevance, while also finding ways to deepen the museum's relationship with frequent visitors and members. This role thinks in terms of the full visitor lifecycle — from first awareness to repeat, loyal engagement — and builds programs that move audiences along that path over time.

The projects can range from managing existing events and programs such as Rooftop Radio , organizing dynamic partner events and pop-ups, to audience surveying and research that builds a deeper understanding of who SFMOMA's audiences are, how they move from curiosity to commitment, and what sustains their long-term connection to the museum. This audience insight directly informs program design and iteration — the role is expected to pilot new ideas, test unconventional channels and partners, and resist formulaic programming in favor of approaches tailored to how different audience segments engage.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this position collaborates closely across departments to ensure all programming is exhibition-aligned, brand-coherent, and seamlessly integrated with museum operations — while keeping an eye on measurable outcomes across the full arc of the visitor relationship, not just single-event attendance.

Responsibilities & Duties

Experiential Programming Strategy & Execution: Own the end-to-end strategy, development, and execution of public-facing experiential programming designed to introduce SFMOMA to new audiences in unexpected contexts both inside and outside the museum, including piloting new formats and partnerships to test what resonates with different audience segments
Audience Insight & Segmentation: Lead audience surveying and research to build ongoing understanding of visitor segments, motivations, and behavior across the lifecycle — from first-time visitors to repeat and loyal audiences — and use these insights to inform program design, targeting, and iteration
Influencer & Creator Partnerships: In partnership with the Social Media Team, lead influencer and creator activations to drive cultural relevance and maximize earned media reach for select exhibitions, events, and programs.
Event Support:
Design member experience events in coordination with the Membership team to deepen loyalty and create aspirational access moments.
Execute press previews and media-facing activations in close partnership with the Communications team.
Partner with Public Events to deliver social programming (such as late-night member and public events that center experiences over curriculum)

Tourism & Convention Initiatives: Collaborate and support tourism-related experiences and events, including participation at annual conventions
Cross-Functional Workflow & Operations: Collaborate regularly with department leadership (Marketing, Communications, Visitor Experience, and Operations) to align priorities and ensure seamless cross-departmental execution
Strategic Measurement & Problem Solving: Drive strategic initiatives by implementing measurement systems, compiling audience and program data to solve complex operational problems, and preparing comprehensive impact reports that track progress across the visitor lifecycle
Maintain positive, collaborative relationships with people across the organization to ensure success of cross-functional initiatives

Qualifications & Skills

Minimum of six (6) years of experience in experiential marketing, cultural programming, brand partnerships, or public-facing live events within museums, live entertainment, hospitality, or creative agencies
Experience with audience research methods (surveys, focus groups, or visitor data analysis) and using insights to shape program strategy and targeting
Robust project management background, with a proven ability to manage multiple complex activations and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Position requires a high level of independence, discretion, and responsibility regarding high-visibility public matters and strategic partnerships
Highly organized, proactive, and capable of anticipating needs, establishing workflows for undefined processes, and navigating changing priorities with tight deadlines
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; capable of building positive, collaborative relationships across internal management, staff, trustees, donors, external creators, and media partners
Excellent computer skills, including strong proficiency in standard office suites and producing impactful presentations.

The Program Manager is accountable for the delivery of Microair Avionics' OEM customer programs and internal development projects, several running concurrently at different stages of maturity.Based at Microair's Indore facility and working across the company's Australian, US, Irish and Indian operations, the role converts customer commitments into achievable plans, keeps those plans honest as they meet reality, and removes whatever stands between the delivery team and the outcome.Authority is held over program scope, schedule baseline, budget and risk disposition within the approved contract, and the position is the delegated voice of Microair to the customer on program matters.Leadership is exercised through influence rather than line authority: the team creates the value, and the Program Manager's job is to enable it.

Key Responsibilities
1. Program OwnershipHold end-to-end accountability for multiple concurrent OEM delivery programs and development projects, from contract award through certification to entry into service and closeout.
2. Scope Translation & PlanningDissect the customer statement of work into a detailed, resourced and achievable plan — work breakdown, schedule, milestones and dependencies — expressed so the delivery team and the customer work from the same picture.
3. Team EnablementOperate on the basis that the team creates customer and company value, not the manager. Clear roadblocks, protect focus, and secure the resources and decisions the team is waiting on, including those held in another time zone.
4. Influence Without AuthoritySecure commitment, priority and follow-through from peers and their teams across Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial — and across the Indian, Australian, Irish and US sites — without relying on positional authority.
5. Customer EngagementAct as the principal customer-facing contact for assigned programs and represent Microair credibly at OEM design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and program gates, contributing to the technical discussion rather than deferring it.
6. Risk & Opportunity ManagementRun living risk and opportunity registers on every program, on the basis that unmanaged risk is the most likely cause of schedule slip. Own mitigations to closure and pursue opportunities with equal discipline.
7. Schedule, Cost & RevenueOwn program schedule, cost and revenue performance. Maintain credible forecasts, manage milestone claims and revenue timing, and escalate early and with options.
8. Change & Variation ControlIdentify scope change as it emerges, assess the schedule and cost impact, and agree variations with the customer before the work is quietly absorbed.
9. Value RealisationDefine how the value created by each program is measured, and test that against what the customer expects and pays for, so any gap surfaces while there is still time to act.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Program Manager to drive planning, execution, and continuous improvement across our Engineering organization. You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), and Sales Engineers (SEs), and you'll need to influence outcomes without direct authority — bringing structure to ambiguous problems and surfacing risks early.

Key Responsibilities

1. Roadmap & Sprint Execution

Translate roadmap objectives into milestones, deliverables, and timelines across Engineering teams.
Own planning and tracking for sprints and projects: define dependencies, track scope changes and blockers, and flag delivery risk before it becomes slippage.
Sequence work across teams based on business priority, capacity, and dependencies; facilitate trade-off discussions when priorities conflict.
Maintain program dashboards as the single source of truth for delivery status.

2. Cross-Functional & Customer Issue Coordination

Serve as the coordination point between Engineering, Product, Customer Supoort, CSMs, and SEs on customer-reported issues.
Track issues from investigation through release and customer validation; drive aging or high-impact issues to resolution.
Ensure decisions, owners, and timelines are documented and communicated; escalate critical issues with clear context and recommended action.

3. Release & Demo Coordination

Coordinate releases across Development, QA, Product, and DevOps; own release timelines and readiness reviews.
Organize feature/sprint demos for CSMs, SEs, and Product; ensure feedback and action items get routed to the right owners.
Support post-release validation and retrospectives for major releases.

4. Quality, RCA & Continuous Improvement

Drive completion of Root Cause Analyses for significant customer-impacting bugs and recurring defects, with clear owners and target dates.
Analyze issue data to spot systemic patterns; partner with Customer Support, Engineering and Product on permanent fixes, not workarounds.
Facilitate retrospectives and ensure findings feed back into planning.

5. Process Improvement

Identify bottlenecks, gaps, and manual effort in existing workflows; design and standardize processes that improve predictability.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tracking and reporting.
Establish metrics to confirm process changes are actually working.
Tracking & Improving Customer Support SLAs.

6. Stakeholder Communication

Run a predictable communication cadence covering progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions needed.
Tailor updates for Engineering, Product, customer-facing teams, and leadership.
Proactively surface deviations from plan — don't wait for escalation.

What We're Looking For

5+ years in Program Management, Technical Program Management, or Engineering Project Management in a software/technology company.
Proven experience driving execution across multiple Engineering teams with interdependent deliverables, in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Track record coordinating cross-functional teams (Engineering, Product, QA, Customer Success, Customer Support, Sales/SE).
Strong stakeholder management — able to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority.
Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, and delivery/reporting tools.
Experience with release management, RCA/defect trend analysis, or engineering dashboards.

Good to Have

Technical background or experience working closely with engineers.
B2B SaaS / enterprise software experience.
Familiarity with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, or application architecture.
Experience with distributed/geographically diverse teams.
PMP, SAFe, or Scrum Master certification.
Strong analytical skills and comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities.

Success in This Role

Roadmap and sprint delivery become measurably more predictable.
Customer-impacting issues resolve faster, with clear ownership and tracking.
Recurring defects decline through consistent RCA follow-through.
Engineering, Customer Support, Product, CSM, and SE teams report better visibility and alignment.

About The Organisation

ASC is Australia’s submarine company. They built the Royal Australian Navy’s Collins Class submarines, sustain them, and are now delivering their Life of Type Extension to increase the boats’ service lives.

They have also been selected by the Australian Government to sustain and jointly build the nation’s nuclear-powered submarines, the largest and most complex industrial undertaking in Australia’s history.

About The Position

This Business Analyst role is in ASC’s Workforce Transformation function, which is playing a crucial role in the ‘hire to retire’ employee lifecycle, as well as future proofing the organisation more generally through a huge period of growth. In principle this is a huge program of work, which encompasses numerous core projects, along with a Workday implementation. This position will play a key role in that workforce transformation program, and as such the work itself is whole-of-system, process, structure, information and technology.

Within the Transformation function you’ll specifically sit within the Business Design team, partnering closely with Change, Communications, Technology and Testing teams. You’ll be expected to move between initiatives, work with managers and staff at every level, and bring structure to problems that arise.

The role

Elicit, document and validate business requirements and processes with stakeholders across the business.
Run current state assessments of processes, systems and structures, and build future state operating models, workflows and process maps.
Conduct gap analysis and business impact analysis, and identify where automation and process redesign will actually pay off.
Contribute to business cases, cost benefit analysis, risk assessment, value propositions.
Facilitate workshops for requirements gathering and problem solving.
Identify data migration, integration and reporting requirements.
Support delivery through to implementation, and measure the benefits afterwards.

What you'll need

Tertiary qualification in business, IT, project management, engineering or similar.
Demonstrated Business Analysis experience within a Transformation program at a large, complex, matrixed organisation.
Inquisitive, proactive in your decision making, and able to act as a genuine business partner to internal customers.
Process mapping and process redesign expertise.
Strong track record of identifying and validating the business impact of change.
Confident facilitating workshops and working with stakeholders at all levels.
Comfortable across both agile and waterfall delivery.
Certification in agile or a business analysis or redesign methodology is well regarded.

Eligibility

This role requires a current National Police Clearance and an Australian Defence Security Clearance. Your eligibility for this role is dependent on you obtaining and maintaining such clearance. To check your eligibility please visit the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website.

Benefits

Unique and challenging work with a deeper purpose.
Flexibility over how, when and where you work for the best work/life balance, this role will primarily be based from the organisation's Adelaide CBD office.
Up to 10 days additional leave every year so you can rest and recharge.
Generous parental leave so you can give your family the focus it deserves.
Subsidised childcare to ease the financial pressure on your family.
Health and wellbeing initiatives so you can perform at your best at work.
Professional development opportunities to advance your career.
A diverse and supportive environment where you can thrive.
Discounts and exclusive offers from leading Australian brands to help you save.
