new_jobs.title: County Facilities Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
The County Executive’s Office is seeking qualified candidates for the position of County Facilities Security Manager.

The County Facilities Security Manager is responsible for supervising and coordinating security operations across five County buildings at County Center and at other County facilities. This role includes managing security agreements, collaborating with law enforcement agencies such as the Sheriff’s Office concerning the Hall of Justice and County Center campus security, and overseeing security infrastructure including surveillance camera systems. The County Facilities Security Manager ensures compliance with security policies that are consistent with industry best practices and maintains safe environments within all assigned facilities.

This position carries full supervisory authority over security staff and vendors, manages security contracts and budgets, engages in strategic security planning and policy development, and collaborates extensively with law enforcement agencies. The role requires advanced knowledge of security strategies, law enforcement coordination, management principles, and contract administration to ensure secure, compliant, and efficient facility operations across the County.

This classification is distinct from law enforcement roles in that it is a civilian management position without peace officer status. The Building Security Manager serves to provide leadership and administrative oversight ensuring effective security management within the County’s public buildings and facilities.

Examples Of Duties

Duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Manage security agreements and contracts for multiple County buildings.
Collaborate with the Sheriff’s Office and other law enforcement agencies regarding the security of the Hall of Justice and other facilities.
Oversee installation, operation, and maintenance of surveillance camera systems and other security technologies at County Center and additional facilities.
Test and conduct security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and recommend improvements.
Manage relationships with third-party security vendors and ensure compliance with security requirements.
Develop, schedule, and conduct safety and security training programs for County personnel, including active shooter response training.
Respond to security incidents and coordinate appropriate follow-up actions.
Supervise and evaluate security staff assigned to County facilities.
Prepare and maintain reports related to security operations, incidents, and compliance.
Participate in long-range planning for facility security enhancements and technology upgrades.
Coordinate emergency preparedness and response activities in collaboration with internal departments and external agencies.
Perform related duties as assigned.

Ideal Candidate

The County Executive’s Office is seeking individuals who demonstrate strong character, professionalism, and a genuine commitment to public service.

Ideal candidates will possess the following characteristics:

Integrity, Ethical Judgment, and Political Astuteness – Demonstrates honesty, accountability, and sound decision-making while maintaining the highest ethical standards.
Commitment to Public Service – Shows a genuine desire to serve others and improve the safety and well-being of the community.
Strong Communication Skills – Communicates effectively both verbally and in writing and interacts professionally with the public, County employees, and the County Executive team.
Emotional Intelligence and Sound Judgment – Remains calm and composed and makes good decisions in stressful or rapidly evolving situations.
Teamwork and Collaboration – Works effectively with others and contributes positively to a professional team environment.
Accountability and Initiative – Demonstrates responsibility, reliability, and self-motivation.
Cultural Awareness and Community Engagement – Values and respects the diverse communities served by the County of San Mateo.

This is a limited-term position:
Limited-term positions are full-time, fully benefited, temporary positions. This current position is funded for up to two years, depending on the department’s needs. Limited Term employees receive medical and dental benefits, like regular employees, and a defined contribution retirement plan (401-A).

Information for current County employees:
Current and regular County of San Mateo Employees who are interested in this assignment must submit application materials and compete in the selection process. If you are successful in the selection process and are being considered for the assignment, HR will work directly with you and/or your department for options. Please note there is no guarantee that you will be allowed by your department to rotate into this assignment nor is your department obligated to allow you to take on this assignment.

If you are chosen for the assignment, it is considered a work-out-of-class or development opportunity. You remain a full-time, regular employee “on loan” to the County Executive’s Office for the duration of the assignment.

The salary range for this position is "as is" and non-negotiable.

Qualifications

Experience and Education:

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge and skills is qualifying. A typical way to qualify is:

Three to five years of extensive security management experience, including significant supervisory responsibilities and contract administration.

Professional certifications such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP) or Physical Security Professional (PSP) from ASIS International are desirable.

Knowledge of:

Principles and practices of managing security operations for public buildings.
Security measures and protocols related to protection of personnel, property, and visitors.
Methods and procedures used in criminal and incident investigations.
Contract administration and vendor management in the context of security services.
Laws, regulations, and industry standards applicable to building security and safety.
Active shooter response planning and emergency preparedness procedures.
Security technology systems including surveillance camera operations and maintenance.
Public administration principles, including supervision, training, and budgeting.
Effective communication techniques for diverse audiences.
Criminal Justice, Public Administration, Business, or a closely related field.

Skill/Ability to:

Manage and coordinate multi-facility security programs effectively.
Collaborate and liaise with law enforcement and other agencies.
Plan and deliver security training and awareness sessions.
Analyze security risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
Lead, supervise, and develop security personnel and vendors.
Evaluate security incidents and recommend preventative measures.
Communicate clearly and professionally both orally and in writing with diverse stakeholders.
Implement and monitor compliance with security policies and contractual agreements.

Application/Examination

This is an Open recruitment. Anyone may apply.

The examination process will consist of an application screening (weight: pass/fail) based on the candidates' application and responses to the supplemental questions. Candidates who pass the application screening will be invited to a panel interview (weight: 100%) which may include a brief writing exercise given immediately prior to the interview.

Depending on the number of applicants, an application appraisal of education and experience may be used in place of other examinations or further evaluation of work experience may be conducted to group applicants by level of qualification. All applicants who meet the minimum qualifications are not guaranteed advancement through any subsequent phase of the examination.

All examinations will be given in San Mateo County, California, and applicants must participate at their own expense.

IMPORTANT: Applications for this position will only be accepted online.
If you are currently on the County's website, you may click the "Apply"
button. If you are not on the County's website, please go to https://jobs.smcgov.org/
to apply.

Responses to the supplemental questions must be submitted in addition to our regular employment application form. A resume will not be accepted as a substitute for the required employment application and supplemental questionnaire.

HiQ:lla missiomme on yksinkertaistaa ihmisten elämää. Syvän ja monipuolisen teknologia- ja toimialaosaamisemme sekä luovan ajattelun avulla taklaamme asiakkaidemme haasteita ja luomme entistä toimivampia ratkaisuja. HiQ:lla rakennetaan aidosti arvokkaita palveluita asiakkaalle.

Meillä pääset rakentamaan yhteiskunnallisesti merkittäviä palveluja, asiakkaiden tarpeet täyttäviä end-to-end -ratkaisuja, kriittisiä taustajärjestelmiä ja meidän kaikkien käyttämiä kuluttajapalveluita. Haluamme olla ylpeitä työstämme, ja pyrimmekin aina parhaimpaamme. Siitä tulee nimemmekin, HiQ, High Quality.

Mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen?

Se on mielenkiintoisia projekteja, afterworkeja, uuden oppimista ja toinen toisemme tukemista. Työkavereita, joista tulee aitoja ystäviä. Lapset saa lähteä hakemaan kotiin etuajassa ja välillä taas puristetaan loppukiri porukalla. Haluamme olla yhteisö, jossa haluat olla vuodesta toiseen. Paikka, jossa voit kehittyä työnantajaa vaihtamatta. Jokainen meistä vaikuttaa siihen, mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen.

Mitä me etsimme?

HiQ:lla AI-, data- ja automaatioasiantuntijamme ovat omistautuneet tunnistamaan ja ratkaisemaan asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaprosessien tehottomuuksia. Pysymme alan trendien kärjessä ja laajennamme jatkuvasti tietämystämme ja kykyjämme tuottaaksemme innovatiivisia ratkaisuja. Tarjoamme asiantuntijaratkaisuja projektitoimitusten ja konsultointipalveluiden kautta asiakkaidemme tarpeiden mukaisesti.

Etsimämme henkilö on taitava kommunikoimaan erilaisten sidosryhmien kanssa ja kykenee selittämään monimutkaisia asioita ymmärrettävällä tavalla kuulijakunnasta riippumatta. Haluamme, että kannat vastuuta omasta työstäsi ja nautit työskentelystä tiimisi ja asiakkaidemme kanssa etkä pelkää uusia haasteita.

Toivomme sinulta:

Useamman vuoden kokemusta datavisualisoinnista ja raportoinnista.
Käytännön kokemusta Power BI:stä (tai vastaavista työkaluista) ja raportointiratkaisujen luomisesta, kehittämisestä ja analysoinnista.
Kokemusta SQL:stä ja/tai Pythonista.
Kykyä tuottaa selkeitä, laadukkaita ja visuaalisesti houkuttelevia raportteja ja analyyseja liiketoiminnan tueksi.
Kykyä toimia asiakasrajapinnassa ja kiinnostusta konsulttityöhön.

Tarjoamme

HiQ:n hauskan ja rennon työyhteisön ja kokeneet tiimikaverit. Vietämme HiQ:lla aikaa yhdessä mm. harrastuskerhojen ja yhteisen tekemisen parissa. Jaamme myös aktiivisesti tietoa, oppeja ja onnistumisia esimerkiksi MojiTechin merkeissä kuukausittain.
Joustavan hybridityömahdollisuuden. Voit työskennellä asiakkaan tiloissa, toimistoillamme tai kotitoimistolta käsin.
Kattavat henkilöstöedut laajasta työterveydestä liikunta- ja kulttuurietuihin, harrastekerhoihin, tapahtumiin ja ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Joustamme HiQ:laisten eri elämäntilanteissa ja haluamme tehdä työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamisesta helppoa.

Hae nyt

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä ja haluaisit kuulla roolista lisää? Positiosta voit kysyä lisää Oona Muilulta (oona.muilu@hiq.fi) tai hae paikkaa suoraan linkin kautta.

Huomioithan, että tehtävään valinnan edellytyksenä on sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito.

new_jobs.description:
THE POSITION

As a Business Analyst 3 with the Municipal Retirement System, you will support essential reporting tools that help guide important retirement services. This role brings you into collaboration with business and technical teams to improve data resources. You will play a key part in strengthening reporting accuracy and system performance. Join this team and help move critical work forward every day.

DESCRIPTION OF WORK

This position focuses on reporting development, data analysis, and support of complex information systems. The role works with business and technical staff to strengthen reporting processes and resolve system issues. As a Business Analyst 3, you will perform the following duties:

Requirements Analysis: Identify reporting and data needs and translate them into system requirements
Report Development: Build and update dashboards, queries, and reporting tools with approved technologies
Data Evaluation: Review data outputs to confirm accuracy and locate inconsistencies
System Coordination: Support system changes and collaborate with technical staff to address issues
Testing Support: Prepare testing materials and assist business users during system updates
User Assistance: Provide training and guidance on reporting solutions and applications

Interested in learning more? Additional details regarding this position can be found in the position description .

Work Schedule and Additional Information:

Full time employment, 37.5 hours per week.
Work hours are 7:45 AM to 4:15 PM, Monday - Friday, with a 60 minute lunch.
Telework: You may have the opportunity to work from home (telework) part-time, up to 2 days per week after successful completion of the training period. In order to telework, you must have a securely configured high-speed internet connection and work from an approved location inside Pennsylvania. If you are unable to telework, you will have the option to report to the headquarters office in Harrisburg, PA. The ability to telework is subject to change at any time. Additional details may be provided during the interview.
Salary: In some cases, the starting salary may be non-negotiable.
You will receive further communication regarding this position via email. Check your email, including spam/junk folders, for these notices.

You must be able to perform essential job functions.

new_jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

RESIDENTIAL PROGRAM MANAGER – ADULT RESIDENTIAL PROGRAM

Full-Time, Salary: $66,300 - $75,000/year

Make a Real Difference Every Day:
Do you want a career where you directly impact lives, experiencing the deep fulfillment that comes from helping others and a strong sense of purpose?

Shifts Available:
Full-time plus on-call 24/7 for emergencies and callouts

About Brightway Living & Learning:
Brightway Living & Learning is a premier non-profit provider of human services on Long Island, including educational, residential, day habilitation, and vocational programs. Building on a 65-year legacy as the Developmental Disabilities Institute (DDI), Brightway supports over 1,600 children and adults with autism and other developmental disabilities through a full continuum of care. By employing persistence, adaptability, and the power of behavioral science, Brightway’s dedicated professionals enable individuals to grow, learn, and meet milestones at their own pace. Discover more about our mission and our "All Ways Forward" approach at brightwayny.org.

The Role:
As a Residential Program Manager, you will play a vital role in supporting individuals with disabilities in their daily lives at our Spring Meadow & Sagamore houses. You will work closely with them and your employees, managing all of the day-to-day operations of the residence. This is a truly rewarding opportunity to build meaningful relationships and make a tangible difference.

What You'll Do

Handle employment and staffing needs for your residence, including hiring, performance evaluations, and supervision of staff, as well as submission of required payroll data.
Maintain knowledge of Emergency Procedures and accurate implementation of procedures in handling crisis situations as they arise.
Train new staff to work with individual(s) served
Ensure all staff have current certifications in all areas (TB, AMAP, CPR, etc.) and provide annual recertification trainings.
Maintain staff schedule, run staff meetings, participate in Interdisciplinary Team Meetings.
Write and implement Annual Program Plan; write formal goals, protocols.
Participate in the writing and implementation of Behavior Plans, and all other components of the Annual Plan (i.e., medical, nutrition, fitness, socialization, etc.).
Evaluate monthly progress as related to short term objectives and formulation of new objectives based on level attained.
Accompany individuals on medical appointments.
Complete Operating Checklist, and all budgetary processes (i.e., petty cash, OTPS, etc.)
Responsible for bookkeeping for individuals: Nami payments, SSI, tax refunds, etc.
Coordinate efforts in all areas: Psychology, Nutrition/Fitness, Nursing, Day Hab and Residential, and Service Coordination.
Complete incident reports and SCIP-R reports as necessary, review for accuracy, and submit monthly
Interface with parents and facilitate their involvement with their son/daughter’s program plan.
Advocate for individuals served and implement new programming ideas, exploring the individuals’ interests.
24-hour on call for staffing/emergency problems
Performs all job functions of the community instructor as needed

What You Need For The Role

High School Diploma, BA/BS preferred
Two years experience working with developmentally disabled adults
Valid NYS driver’s license, preferred [NOTE: Positions for non-approved drivers are NOT available in all programs and are based on program needs.]*
Working knowledge of Applied Behavior Analysis and Positive Behavioral Support
Must be able to modify the area to secure the safety of the adults i.e. move/push tables and other heavy objects up to 20 lbs.
Must be able to lift/move/carry 20 lbs.
Must be able to run after an individual up to 500 feet
Must be able to run to a program in need up to 500 feet
Must be able to kneel, twist and bend
Must be able to respond to fire alarms
Must be able to perform all physical SCIP techniques

Why You'll Love This Job

Build Meaningful Relationships: Develop strong connections with individuals and their families.
Learn and Grow: Benefit from ongoing training and professional development.
Be Part of a Supportive Team: Work with passionate and dedicated colleagues.
Experience Job Satisfaction: Feel a deep sense of accomplishment knowing your work matters.
Exceptional Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off.

Here’s How We Support You

Comprehensive Paid Training: Get the skills you need to succeed.
Exceptional Benefits: Including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, FSA, and EAP.
Retirement Security: 403(b) retirement plan.
Invest in Your Future: Tuition reimbursement opportunities.
Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within Brightway Living & Learning.
And More: Paid time off and other valuable benefits!

If You Are

Empathic, compassionate, and patient
Positive, energetic, and enthusiastic
A good communicator and team player
Passionate about making a difference

Then, we encourage you to apply and join the Brightway Living & Learning team!

When you join our team, you become part of the Brightway Living & Learning Family! Click here to watch our video to find out more about the Brightway Living & Learning Family.

Brightway Living & Learning is committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees without regard to actual or perceived race, color, sex, pregnancy, reproductive decision making, gender expression or identity, national origin, disability, military status, creed, religion, age, sexual orientation, marital status, genetic information, status as a victim of domestic violence or any other group protected by federal, state or local law. We are committed to creating a deep sense of belonging and a culture where all applicants and employees feel welcomed, valued and respected. We are people inspired by purpose

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager based in the United States.

As a Project Manager, you will coordinate complex customer engagements across technical demonstrations, implementations, integrations, and ongoing support.

Working within a Solutions Engineering environment, you will serve as a central point of coordination between customers and internal technical, sales, and product teams.

You will own project planning, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and communications to ensure successful delivery.

The role combines customer relationship management with strong project execution and requires the ability to navigate technical and business requirements.

You will contribute from the pre-sales stage through post-sales delivery, helping align expectations, resources, and commitments.

This is an opportunity to work on advanced radar and sensing technologies supporting applications across transportation, security, aerospace, and autonomous systems.

Accountabilities

Act as the primary project coordinator for prospect and customer delivery engagements, ensuring clear communication, stakeholder alignment, and effective execution.
Plan, schedule, and oversee customer implementations, integrations, technical demonstrations, and related engagements.
Serve as the main customer point of contact for project status, progress updates, issues, and escalations.
Partner closely with Solutions Engineers, Sales, Product, and other internal stakeholders to ensure customer commitments are properly scoped, understood, and delivered.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, documentation, and other delivery materials.
Track milestones, dependencies, resources, and project risks while proactively identifying and addressing issues that could affect timelines or outcomes.
Support pre-sales activities by helping define delivery timelines, customer requirements, resource needs, and implementation considerations.
Build strong, trusted relationships with customers and maintain a customer-first approach throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Coordinate multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously while maintaining visibility into priorities, deliverables, and potential blockers.
Contribute to successful post-sales support and long-term customer engagement by ensuring projects are delivered with a strong focus on quality and customer satisfaction.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
At least 5 years of experience in project management, technical program management, services delivery, or a closely related discipline.
Proven experience managing customer-facing projects involving multiple technical and business stakeholders.
Experience working in a technology, engineering, or similarly technical environment is preferred.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines effectively.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to establish productive relationships with customers and internal teams.
Strong customer-first mindset and demonstrated ability to manage expectations, resolve issues, and communicate project status clearly.
Familiarity with radar, sensors, aerospace and defense, autonomous systems, or related technology industries is a plus.
Experience working with government or defense customers is strongly preferred.
PMP, Scrum Master, or another recognized project management certification is desirable but not required.
Ability to proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and maintain project momentum in a dynamic environment.
Willingness and ability to travel moderately as required by customer and project needs.
Due to U.S. government export-control requirements, candidates must identify whether they are a U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident/green card holder, or have been granted asylum or refugee status in the United States, as applicable to eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required government authorizations.

Benefits

Expected annual salary range of $104,030–$155,839 USD.
Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees.
Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA medical plans.
Virtual care through 98Point6.
Employee Assistance Program.
Mental health coverage through Spring Health and Talkspace.
Travel assistance insurance.
Company-paid life insurance.
Company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage.
Flexible PTO for exempt employees.
401(k) matching.
Pet insurance.
Prepaid legal program.
Commuter benefits.
Paid company holidays.
Remote work within the United States.
Opportunity to work on advanced radar and sensing technologies across autonomous systems, transportation, critical infrastructure, security, aerospace, and related markets.

Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for the ITAM solution.
Conduct business process and system analysis, design, improvement, and implementation efforts to align with modernization goals.

Collaborate with technical teams to validate requirements, track development progress, and support solution design decisions.

Maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor and ensuring transparency throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide input into training materials, user guides, and adoption strategies to support successful implementation.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
10+ years of relevant experience

Proven experience working as a Business Analyst on ServiceNow projects, with exposure to ITAM or related modules (ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, GRC, Security Ops).
Advanced experience in business process and system analysis, design, improvement, and implementation.
Demonstrated ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements and solutions.

Experience supporting modernization or migration from legacy systems to ServiceNow platforms.

Experience working in government, public sector, or other regulated environments.

Eligible to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.

The Project Manager I is responsible for managing construction projects from award through closeout while ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with contract requirements and company standards. Manage assigned construction projects from project award through final closeout.
Develop project budgets, schedules, forecasts, and cash flow projections.
Review and interpret project plans, specifications, and contract documents.
Oversee subcontractor procurement, contract execution, and performance.
Manage project cost tracking, change orders, and financial reporting.
Coordinate project scheduling, material procurement, and equipment needs.
Serve as the primary point of contact with owners, inspectors, engineers, and subcontractors.
Partner with Superintendents to ensure jobsite productivity, safety compliance, and quality control.
Review and approve project billing, progress payments, and job cost reports.
Manage RFIs, submittals, change requests, and contract modifications.
Conduct project meetings, job walks, and stakeholder coordination meetings.
Support project risk management, issue resolution, and claims avoidance.
Ensure compliance with company safety standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate, organized, and complete project documentation.
Support project closeout including as-builts, warranties, final billing, and turnover documentation.
Maintain confidentiality of project financials, contracts, and company business information.
Performs other related duties as required or assigned. Responsibilities may be modified or added based on operational needs and business priorities.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
Equivalent construction and project management experience may be substituted.

Experience

5–8 years of progressive construction, utilities, or civil project management experience required.
Experience managing underground utilities, wet utilities, or civil infrastructure projects strongly preferred.

Licenses/Certifications (if Applicable)

OSHA 30 preferred.
Valid California driver’s license required.

Skills

Strong knowledge of construction project management processes and job cost control.
Strong understanding of plans, specifications, and contract documents.
Strong budgeting, forecasting, and schedule management skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Proficiency with project management software, estimating tools, and Microsoft Excel.
Strong problem-solving, leadership, and decision-making abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional project team.
Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive project and company information.

Overview

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Allied Universal® is hiring a Project Manager. The Project Manager will administratively support regional leadership by managing and tracking deliverable, managing project deadlines, driving Key Performance Indicator (KPI) achievement and company initiatives.

Responsibilities

Ensure direct and indirect reports meet company standards pertaining to quality of work performed on an ongoing basis
Develop and implement training materials; regional processes and procedures
Lead strategic projects; direct the work of regional management; establish and delegate deadlines
Develop and support the implementation of performance improvement plans
Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project plans, timelines, and deliverables
Partner with regional leaders to complete client-based projects, identifying areas for improvement
Create, track, and maintain various weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports utilizing internal systems and dashboards
Provide administrative support as assigned by the region, to include submitting travel arrangements, printing, copying, processing invoices and submitting expense reports
Prepare and distribute correspondence, memos, reports, and other documents as requested

Qualifications

Must possess one or more of the following:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Criminal Justice, or a related field
Associate’s Degree in Business Administration, Criminal Justice, or a related field with a minimum of three (3) years of administrative management experience
High school diploma or equivalent with a minimum of five (5) years of administrative management experience

Administrative management experience in an office setting
Highly proficient in all Microsoft Office applications and able to effectively utilize multiple systems and applications
Ability to work with new or existing presentation to create and deliver appealing, persuasive, and effective presentations
Demonstrated problem solving, confidence and decision-making ability to manage shifting priorities, demands and timelines in a fast-paced environment
Strong financial skills with the ability to analyze data and report on regional metrics
Ability to prioritize workload based on urgency; able to delegate time sensitive tasks and communicate to a range of audiences including to executive management

Bonus Qualifications (not Required)

Project management experience

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, and disability insurance
Enrollment in our company’s 401(k)plan, subject to eligibility requirements
Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days
Vacation time offered at an accrual rate of 3.08 hours biweekly. Unused vacation is only paid out where required by law.

Pay

$150,000 - 165,000/yr.

Closing
